hireworks is building a community of top talent in key international markets by unlocking unparalleled access to positions at leading U.S. based companies. As your employer, hireworks will ensure you have a seamless interview, onboarding, and employee experience - providing ongoing support and resources along the way. Working with hireworks means unlocking access to a network of local peers and mentors and career opportunities through our client network.

About our client

Our client is an innovative bakery + delivery concept that has become a cult brand known for its rabid following of cookie lovers who crave Insomnia's warm, delicious delivery all day and late into the night.

Today, they span more than 350 bakeries worldwide, including its flagship location in Philadelphia, PA, where the company is proudly headquartered. As they continue to grow their footprint and bring warm cookies to new communities across the globe, they are revolutionizing the cookie game by truly imagining what's possible.

About the Position:

This person will own the entire digital marketing ecosystem, with the goal of driving customer acquisition, loyalty enrollment, repeat purchases, and revenue growth across 350+ locations.

This is a hands-on digital marketing leadership role, not a purely strategic position. They'll manage agencies and digital budgets while also getting directly involved in CRM execution, customer segmentation, campaign planning, and performance optimization.

  • Loyalty: Own rewards, including program structure, earn/burn mechanics, member engagement, retention, and program economics.
  • CRM & Lifecycle Marketing: Manage email, SMS, push notifications, customer journeys, personalization, and segmentation.
  • Paid Media: Oversee agencies, budgets, paid search/social, ROAS, customer acquisition costs, and retargeting.
  • SEO: Drive technical, local, and organic SEO across 350+ store locations.
  • Third-Party Delivery: Manage DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub relationships, promotions, and performance.
  • Community Growth: Build Reddit and community engagement strategies that support acquisition and loyalty.
  • Data & Personalization: Leverage first-party customer data to improve targeting, conversion, retention, and lifetime value.

About You:

  • 6+ years in digital marketing, ideally with strong ownership of CRM, loyalty, and performance marketing.
  • Hands-on experience building customer segments, automated journeys, and campaigns.

  • Strong agency management and performance measurement experience.

  • Experience in QSR, restaurants, grocery, retail, e-commerce, or consumer subscription businesses preferred.
  • Comfortable operating strategically while remaining involved in execution.

Benefits:

hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across LATAM. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career


The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.


You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.


Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. FLIGHT blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.


Your Impact


  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting

Qualifications

Your Experience


  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Pismo is seeking a Sr. Support Engineer specializing in Cloud Platform and Pismo Core Platform to support enterprise clients within the Enterprise Support team.

This role focuses on platform stability, infrastructure behavior, and core product capabilities such as shared platform services and integrations. The Support Engineer works closely with Engineering teams to investigate issues, understand system behavior, and improve operational efficiency.

The Support Engineer acts as a technical bridge between clients, TAMs, and Engineering, contributing to faster diagnosis, better system understanding, and continuous improvement.

You will also play a key role in building and evolving internal tools, automation, and AI-driven solutions to scale support operations and improve efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support across cloud and core platform domains, including infrastructure, APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Investigate complex technical issues, analyzing system behavior, logs, and interactions across services
  • Support incident management, contributing to troubleshooting and analysis during high-severity incidents
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering teams, ensuring clear communication of findings and validation of system behavior
  • Validate platform changes and releases, assessing potential impact to client environments and integrations
  • Contribute to platform understanding, documenting patterns, common issues, and operational insights
  • Develop internal tools and automation, improving diagnostics, monitoring, and support workflows
  • Leverage AI and automation, building or contributing to AI-driven tools (e.g., agents, workflows) to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort

Technical Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of cloud environments and distributed systems
  • Solid knowledge of APIs, integrations, and service-to-service communication
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and system behavior across multiple services
  • Understanding of platform-level components such as orchestration, ledger, and shared services
  • Experience with incident troubleshooting and root cause analysis in complex systems
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, or internal tooling development
  • Understanding of release and change impact on distributed platforms
  • Strong collaboration and clear communication across teams and stakeholders
  • Ownership and structured problem-solving for end-to-end issue handling
  • Proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement and automation

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Proven experience in cloud platforms, SaaS, or distributed systems environments
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and service-based architectures
  • Background in technical support, SRE, or engineering-related roles, with exposure to production systems
  • Experience with incident management and troubleshooting, including root cause analysis

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with high-availability systems and operational support for critical services
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and system interactions across multiple components
  • Experience collaborating with engineering teams on investigations and system validation
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, or developing internal tools, with exposure to AI-driven approaches as a plus

Technical Skills

  • Issue Investigation Effectiveness — Accuracy and depth of technical analysis, including quality of root cause identification and diagnostics
  • Incident Contribution & Resolution Support — Effectiveness in supporting high-severity incidents through timely analysis and coordination with Engineering and TAMs
  • Transaction & System Insight Quality — Ability to analyze transaction flows, logs, and data to identify patterns, anomalies, and root causes
  • Operational Efficiency Improvement — Contributions to internal tools, automation, or AI-driven solutions that improve troubleshooting and support processes
  • Collaboration & Engineering Feedback — Quality of collaboration with Engineering teams, including clarity of technical findings and actionable feedback

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

  • Proven track record of achieving revenue, premium growth, or other sales objectives.
  • Experience developing strategic account plans, negotiating contracts, and managing complex business development opportunities.
  • Established relationships with national agencies, brokers, carriers, or other insurance industry partners strongly preferred.
  • Bilingual Spanish preferred.

Required Job Skills

  • Ability to develop and execute business strategies that drive profitable growth and expand strategic partnerships.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills to evaluate account performance, market opportunities, risks, and business profitability.

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to independently manage competing priorities and deadlines.

raw.excerpt: About the ClientOur client is an AI-native product company built to replace how billions of people manage their digital lives — starting with email, notes, and task tools that were never designed to be AI-native.
raw.description:
About the Client

Our client is an AI-native product company built to replace how billions of people manage their digital lives — starting with email, notes, and task tools that were never designed to be AI-native. It's backed by multi-million-dollar investment and built remote-first from day one, with a clear target: cut the time it takes users to get everyday things done by roughly 90%. That means solving the problems most AI products avoid — long-running workflows, persistent context, and reliable behavior under real-world, non-deterministic conditions. The team is small and high-talent-density by design, not by necessity, and moves at a pace that matches the scale of what it's building.

About the Role

As a Backend Engineer, AI, you'll own the inference and orchestration layer that powers every AI interaction in the product. Your work sits between models and users, where latency, correctness, reliability, and cost directly shape real-world experience. You'll build and operate production systems that turn model capability into fast, stable, observable APIs used across mobile and desktop clients.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and operate backend systems that serve AI-powered features in production

  • Design inference pipelines, orchestration layers, and service boundaries around models

  • Own production concerns: monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response

  • Optimize latency and throughput across inference, caching, batching, and streaming

Requirements

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals in production environments

  • Experience running high-throughput, low-latency services

  • Familiarity with AI inference patterns (LLMs, embeddings, multimodal)

  • Comfortable debugging distributed systems under load

  • A bias toward shipping and learning from production behavior

Tech Stack

Python · Node.js · PyTorch · OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs · SQL & NoSQL · Kubernetes · Docker

What Success Looks Like

  • Backend systems run reliably at scale, handling production AI traffic with low latency and high throughput

  • APIs are stable, clear, and support seamless integration with frontend and ML systems

  • Production incidents are detected, diagnosed, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact

  • Iterative improvements based on real usage continuously raise system performance and reliability

What to Expect

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class, hands-on teams. Decisions are made collectively, at rapid speed — balancing high-quality shipping with fast learning. You'll be expected to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently.

Compensation and benefits are competitive and vary by location; the package includes base salary and equity, discussed openly with you as part of the process.

If there's a fit, expect 3–4 interviews total, followed by a prompt, transparent decision.

raw.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

The team builds observability for AI in Honeycomb. We help customers see what their agents are doing, what those agents cost, and where errors happen. We also give them insight into individual conversations so they can debug them. We're bringing LLM and agent observability together, and we own both the data foundation and the product experiences built on top of it. You'll work in a small, cross-functional group of engineers with a dedicated product manager and designer, shipping features customers use in production. If you want to define how people understand and debug AI systems, this is the team for you.

What you’ll do in the role:

  • Own end-to-end development of AI observability capabilities, from ingestion to in-product visualizations.
  • Architect and evolve the data model and infrastructure that let us observe agents and their ecosystems across the Honeycomb product.
  • Build systems that analyze and surface AI-specific signals, such as cost, token usage, errors, and anomalies.
  • Collaborate with product and design partners to make sure what we build is usable, intuitive, and unlocks meaningful user workflows.
  • Teach best practices for exploring and understanding AI system behavior across conversations and workloads.
  • Iterate through fast feedback loops and experimentation, and share both wins and failures.

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • Significant software engineering experience, with a record of shipping and owning features end to end.
  • Experience shipping customer-facing features at a SaaS company, beyond internal tooling.
  • Full-stack range, with proficiency in backend development (Go and/or Python) and frontend development (TypeScript and React).
  • A track record of working closely with product managers and designers.
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day engineering work.
  • Experience being on call. You'd join our rotation after about 90 days.
  • A track record of navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving field where requirements shift and experimentation is a core part of the job.
  • Bonus: Experience building LLM or agent-powered features in production.
  • Bonus: Hands-on experience with observability tooling, such as OpenTelemetry.
Base Salary based on level of experience
$183,340—$206,000 USD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

Diventa conducente professionale con DriiveMe Partner

Accedi a incarichi retribuiti di trasferimento veicoli in tutta Italia, con un’organizzazione flessibile e spese di viaggio rimborsate.

👉Iscriviti qui per accedere agli incarichi:

DriiveMe è la piattaforma leader europea nel trasferimento di veicoli. Ogni mese vengono proposti più di 20.000 incarichi retribuiti alla nostra community di autisti autonomi in tutta Italia.

I grandi operatori del settore automobilistico si affidano a DriiveMe per spostare i loro veicoli: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar e molti altri.

In tutta Italia, centinaia di aziende hanno bisogno di spostare veicoli da un punto A a un punto B. Ogni giorno pubblicano le loro richieste su DriiveMe per proporre questi incarichi alla community DriiveMe Partner.

In cosa consiste un incarico DriiveMe?

È semplice: come autista autonomo, guidi un veicolo da un punto A a un punto B. Ecco come funziona:

  1. Crei il tuo account sudriiveme.com.

  2. Accedi agli incarichi disponibili nella tua zona.

  3. Consultii il tragitto, il compenso e le condizioni di ogni incarico.

  4. Prenoti in pochi clic gli incarichi che desideri svolgere.

  5. Il giorno dell’incarico, ti presenti al punto di partenza, ritiri il veicolo e lo consegni al punto di arrivo.

  6. Una volta terminato e convalidato l’incarico, ricevi automaticamente il pagamento entro 10 giorni.

Perché diventare autista autonomo con DriiveMe Partner?

  • Entrate aggiuntive: ogni incarico è retribuito, con un compenso noto in anticipo.

  • Organizzazione flessibile: scegli liberamente gli incarichi che desideri svolgere.

  • Spese di viaggio rimborsate: carburante e pedaggi sono rimborsati secondo le condizioni dell’incarico.

  • Piattaforma semplice e intuitiva: consultazione, prenotazione e gestione degli incarichi online.

  • Incarichi in tutta Italia: ogni giorno vengono pubblicate nuove opportunità.

Quanto posso guadagnare?

Il tuo fatturato dipende dal numero di incarichi che decidi di svolgere.

Ogni incarico prevede un compenso specifico, definito in base al tragitto, al numero di chilometri e alla complessità del trasporto.

Prima di prenotare un incarico, conosci tutte le informazioni essenziali: luogo di partenza, luogo di arrivo, compenso e condizioni di presa in carico. Sei libero di prenotare solo gli incarichi che ti interessano.

Profilo ricercato

Per entrare a far parte di DriiveMe Partner, idealmente devi:

  • avere una patente di guida valida;

  • essere autonomo o disponibile a diventarlo;

  • essere serio, puntuale e preciso;

  • rispettare le procedure di ritiro e consegna dei veicoli;

  • essere disponibile a svolgere incarichi occasionali nella tua zona o in altre parti d’Italia.

Iscriviti ora

Le iscrizioni degli autisti sono centralizzate sulla pagina ufficiale DriiveMe.

Become a self-employed driver with DriiveMe Partner

Access paid vehicle delivery assignments across the United Kingdom, with flexible organisation and road expenses covered.

👉Sign up here to access available jobs:

DriiveMe is Europe’s leading platform for vehicle deliveries. Every month, more than 20,000 paid assignments are offered to our community of self-employed drivers across the United Kingdom.

Major automotive companies trust DriiveMe to move their vehicles, including Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Europcar, and many more.

Across the United Kingdom, hundreds of businesses need vehicles moved from point A to point B. They publish their requirements on DriiveMe every day, making these paid assignments available to the DriiveMe Partner community.

What does a DriiveMe assignment involve?

It is simple: as a self-employed driver, you drive a vehicle from a collection point to a delivery point. Here is how it works:

  1. You create your account ondriiveme.com.

  2. You access the available assignments in your area.

  3. You review the route, payment and conditions for each assignment.

  4. You book the assignments you want to complete in just a few clicks.

  5. On the day of the assignment, you go to the collection point, collect the vehicle and deliver it to the destination.

  6. Once the assignment has been completed and validated, you receive your payment automatically within 10 days.

Why become a self-employed driver with DriiveMe Partner?

  • Additional income: every assignment is paid, with the price known in advance.

  • Flexible organisation: you choose the assignments you want to complete.

  • Road expenses covered: fuel and tolls are reimbursed according to the conditions of the assignment.

  • Simple and intuitive platform: view, book and manage assignments online.

  • Assignments across the UK: new opportunities are published every day.

How much will I earn?

Your turnover depends on the number of assignments you choose to complete.

Each assignment has its own payment, based on the route, the number of miles and the complexity of the transport.

Before booking an assignment, you know all the essential information: collection point, delivery point, payment and conditions. You are free to book only the assignments that suit you.

Profile required

To join DriiveMe Partner, you should ideally:

  • hold a valid driving licence;

  • be self-employed or willing to become self-employed;

  • be reliable, punctual and thorough;

  • follow the vehicle collection and delivery procedures;

  • be available to complete occasional assignments in your area or elsewhere in the United Kingdom.

raw.description:
About Us

Zoo is building the next generation of hardware design tools redefining how hardware products are designed, developed, and built. Our platform combines a modern, cloud-native CAD environment with AI-powered engineering workflows, helping teams design, iterate, and manufacture products faster than ever before. We are headquartered in Los Angeles, CA with both a local and remote team. We were founded and incubated by Embedded Ventures in 2021.

About You

We’re looking for curious, innovative, and ambitious self-starters to join our growing team to help us bring our mission to life. We think you’ll thrive on our team if you’re:

  • Curious at your core, with an eagerness to learn and do things differently
  • Customer-focused, always thinking about ways to improve the user experience
  • Able to operate autonomously and work asynchronously, while also being an effective team player

About The Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer to partner with our sales team and prospective customers on how Zoo can best address their use cases and technical requirements. We believe in a world full of modern software tools for hardware design that allow anyone to develop solutions on top of our infrastructure. You will be responsible for proactively pushing deals forward by overcoming technical objections and positioning Zoo solutions that align with customer objectives. You will ensure a successful transition to the post-sale stage of the customer lifecycle, and partner with customer teams and internal teams to drive adoption of new products by existing customers. You will be expected to have significant knowledge of the hardware design ecosystem, software development, and a deep understanding of how customers can best utilize Zoo’s products.

What You’ll Do

  • Engage with Zoo customers and guarantee success of their specific use cases built on top of Zoo’s APIs
  • Develop a deep understanding of Zoo products and how to position with customers
  • Build highly interactive and engaging customer demonstrations in order to educate potential customers and share best practices on integration throughout the sales cycle
  • Collect requirements, and provide guidance and best practices to apply Zoo products and technologies to achieve customers' business goals
  • Partner with our team to translate prospect feedback into meaningful product insights
  • Work closely with sales to jointly close new enterprise customers
  • Guide new Zoo enterprise customers, helping them execute impactful proof-of-concept projects with a focus on revealing ROI-driven results
  • Assist sales as the technical expert to close deeper commercial production deals after a proof-of-concept concludes

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Demonstrated experience in a customer facing engineering role, with a track record of supporting technical sales to large enterprise customers
  • Ability to understand customers’ workflows, requirements, and decision processes, then translate those insights into effective technical solutions
  • Ability to lead technical evaluations and manage requirements, next steps, and follow-through across multiple accounts
  • Comfort working across a range of enterprise customers through technical, security, and compliance requirements, including handling ITAR-controlled data under established procedures
  • Knowledge of CAD software
  • General engineering acumen with a practical understanding of APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Codex
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to explain current capabilities, limitations, and potential roadmap solutions without overpromising
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to engage executives and explain complex technical concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences

The compensation range for this role is provided below which includes salary + commission. The final offer will depend on multiple factors including candidate experience, skills, expertise, and market data. Compensation may vary by geography.

In addition, we offer competitive equity as well as a full benefits package which may vary by geography as well.

Salary + Commission
$150,000—$210,000 USD

Zoo is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Zoo team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals from across the globe. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, Veteran status, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. raw.excerpt: What is SeekOut?  SeekOut is a leader in AI-driven talent optimization, helping organizations recruit, reskill, and redeploy talent with AI-driven solutions.
raw.description:
What is SeekOut?  

SeekOut is a leader in AI-driven talent optimization, helping organizations recruit, reskill, and redeploy talent with AI-driven solutions. SeekOut transforms how companies build winning teams by empowering organizations to align talent strategy with business strategy via breakthrough agentic AI solutions. Our software and services help companies ensure that they hire the right people and match their talent to the highest-impact roles to drive business success. 

What are we looking to add to our team?

We’re looking for a SeniorProduct Designer who is deeply creative, visually opinionated, and energized by hard, undefined problems. This role is for a designer who thinks beyond patterns, challenges conventions, and takes pride in exceptional craft. You are bold in your ideas, brave in your execution, and uncompromising when it comes to visual quality. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast without losing taste, and believe great design should feel intentional, surprising, and deeply human.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Invent the future of AI recruiting. Design precedent-setting AI and ML-driven product experiences where there is no established playbook, balancing usability, trust, and delight.
  • Create bold 0→1 experiences. Explore new interaction models, visual languages, and product concepts that push beyond conventional enterprise UX.
  • Design with taste and intention. Produce high-craft, polished design work across flows, surfaces, and systems with a strong point of view on visual quality.
  • Rapidly iterate and refine. Generate, test, and evolve ideas quickly, moving from rough concepts to confident solutions with speed and clarity.
  • Tell compelling product stories. Use visuals, prototypes, and narrative to clearly communicate the intent, emotion, and experience behind your designs.
  • Make it real. Translate conceptual thinking into production-ready designs that engineers can build and users can immediately understand.
  • Build and extend design systems. Contribute to scalable, well-structured design systems that enable fast iteration while maintaining a high visual bar.
  • Leverage modern design tools. Work fluently in Figma, using components, variables, auto-layout, and prototyping to move efficiently from idea to execution.
  • Experiment with generative AI. Use generative AI tools to explore concepts, accelerate ideation, and push creative boundaries in how products are imagined and designed.
  • Stay curious and experimental. Continuously explore emerging AI capabilities, interaction paradigms, and visual trends to keep SeekOut’s products modern and distinctive.

What you’ll accomplish in your first 6–12 months:

  • Deliver standout, high-impact 0→1 designs for new AI-driven recruiting and talent products.
  • Raise the visual and experiential bar on the product surfaces you own.
  • Ship designs that meaningfully improve clarity, trust, and delight in complex workflows.
  • Demonstrate rapid iteration cycles that balance speed, exploration, and exceptional craft.

What you’ll bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of experience designing and shipping high-quality product experiences in SaaS, enterprise, or AI-driven software.
  • Proven success delivering 0→1 products or features in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Exceptional visual design skills, with a sharp eye for layout, typography, motion, and interaction detail.
  • High proficiency in Figma, including advanced use of components, variables, auto-layout, prototyping, and design systems.
  • Deep experience working within and extending design systems without sacrificing creativity or quality.
  • Strong ability to rapidly iterate, explore multiple directions, and converge on high-confidence solutions.
  • Experience using generative AI design tools as part of the creative process is a major plus.
  • Comfort challenging assumptions and proposing unconventional solutions when the problem demands it.
  • A deep passion for craft, aesthetics, and pushing quality beyond “good enough.”
  • A portfolio that clearly demonstrates creative range, bold thinking, rapid iteration, and outstanding execution across real products.

A design portfolio is a requirement to be considered for this role. To confirm you’ve read this posting, enter the word LIGHTHOUSE in the question at the end of the application.

Our Commitment to Pay Fairness:

At SeekOut, pay equity is at the heart of our compensation philosophy and approach. Our goal is to provide a transparent, fair and rewarding environment where team members are equitably compensated for substantially similar work, feel supported, and ultimately choose to grow their careers here at SeekOut.  To ensure fairness for new hires and existing team members, we factor in an individual's unique skills and experience, market data, and the internal equity of the team.  

  

Base Salary Hiring Range: $145,000-$170,000 annually. This position will work with our Seattle office and our India office.

SeekOut offers an industry-leading benefits package which includes:

  • Health benefits including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, health savings and flexible spending accounts 
  • Stock Options 
  • Stipends for home office, education, and wellness 
  • Flexible paid time off 
  • Company paid holidays, including Juneteenth and Indigenous People’s Day
  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Retirement plan with company match

This position requires U.S. work authorization and is not eligible for sponsorship.

Our Dedication to a Diverse Workforce:

SeekOut condemns discrimination, racism, and racial injustice in all forms. Committed to attracting and retaining a diverse staff, SeekOut will honor your experiences, perspectives, and unique identity. Together, we strive to create and maintain working and learning environments that are inclusive, equitable and welcoming. We are accelerating our efforts through our products and policies to take action and advance definitive, measurable policies and practices that eliminate racism and discrimination.    

SeekOut is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

About Cleerly

We’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world’s leading cardiologists and are a growing team of world-class engineering, operations, medical affairs, marketing, and sales leaders. We raised $223M in Series C funding in 2022 which has enabled rapid growth and continued support of our mission. In December 2024 we received an additional $106M in a Series C extension funding. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on-site in a location.

Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value-based, AI-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly’s solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world’s largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person’s risk of heart attacks.

At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.

While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.
Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle. Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.

About the Opportunity

We’re seeking a Software Engineer III with strong fullstack skills to help scale and evolve our enterprise-grade platform for quantitative computer-aided diagnosis. In this role, you’ll be a key contributor to the development of secure, reliable, and maintainable systems, delivering high-impact features and improving the foundation that powers our healthcare solutions.

The Operational System team owns the Core Lab Case Management platform, which is the central nervous system of our laboratory operations. We build the workflows that orchestrate the lifecycle of each case, ensuring that complex case data moves seamlessly through the lab and is categorized and prioritized correctly. By optimizing how cases are processed, we ensure our operations remain scalable and our COGS grows efficiently, not linearly, alongside our business.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5–8 years of professional experience as a software engineer, including fullstack development.
  • Proficiency in React, CSS, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with relational databases like PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, system design, and debugging.
  • Ability to take ownership of medium-to-large features and follow through from idea to production.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, especially in distributed environments.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with regulated domains (e.g., healthcare, fintech) and high-availability infrastructure.
  • Experience with containerized cloud environments (Docker, AWS EKS), CI/CD automation, and infrastructure as code.
  • Exposure to event-driven architecture or microservices with asynchronous workflows.
  • Familiarity with Python is a plus

Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable backend services (Node.js, TypeScript) and performant user-facing applications (React, Next.js).
  • Build performant, accessible, and user-friendly interfaces with modern UI frameworks (Ant).
  • Write testable, observable, and maintainable code that meets our performance and quality standards.
  • Participate in system design reviews and propose practical, scalable improvements.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teammates in an agile team to deliver reliable solutions to stakeholders.
  • Contribute to documentation, code reviews, and shared engineering standards.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and assist with triaging production issues.

OUR COMPANY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.

Job duties, activities, and responsibilities are subject to change by our company.

The base salary range for this role varies by location and is aligned to market benchmarks.

  • Candidates located in higher-cost labor markets, including California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Washington, DC represent the middle to high end of the range, while candidates located in all other U.S. locations represent the low to middle end of the range.
  • Final compensation is determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity.

This role is eligible for a 15% target annual bonus, resulting in the following base salary and Total Target Compensation (TTC) ranges:

  • Base Salary: $129,000 - $152,000
  • TTC: $141,900 - $165,200

raw.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Offline is the biggest open opportunity on our growth team, and we’re excited to find someone to own the building of it with the right partners and a measurement-first model. You’ll own TV (linear + CTV), podcast, and direct mail end to end: partners, budget, testing, and the scale-or-cut calls. You’ll report to our VP of Growth and run the function independently, with a direct line to our CMO.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment, and also come together on a quarterly basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Relaunch and scale TV (linear + CTV) with Tatari: rebuild the plan, own creative rotation, and ramp spend on evidence, not gut
  • Rebuild our podcast program: choose the buying model (partner or in-house), select shows, set the DAI vs. host-read strategy, and put promo-code attribution in place
  • Scale direct mail profitably with our partners, and push on both strategy and measurement
  • Own offline measurement end to end: design and read Haus geo tests and holdouts, triangulate with post-purchase surveys and promo codes
  • Set and defend offline budgets, make scale/cut calls with conviction, and present them to leadership
  • Hold agency and partner teams to clear KPIs, and work with our creative team to make better TV, DM, and podcast assets
  • Build the quarterly test roadmap and the 2027 offline plan, including upfront decisions and new reach bets (OOH, sponsorships, portfolio buys)

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 8+ years in performance or growth marketing, including 4+ years owning offline channels (TV, podcast/audio, direct mail) brand-side at a DTC or consumer subscription brand
  • Has personally scaled an offline channel from test to meaningful budget
  • Has managed partners like Tatari, Oxford Road, Ad Results Media, PostPilot, or Lob (agency-side leaders who owned results, not just execution, are welcome)
  • Designs and reads incrementality tests (geo holdouts, matched-market, platform lift) and knows how to calibrate an MMM with experiments
  • Knows TV buying and reporting (Tatari, iSpot), linear vs. CTV economics, and podcast buying (host-read vs. DAI, Magellan, Podscribe)
  • Understands direct mail audience modeling, holdout design, and response curves
  • Ties brand tracking (Tracksuit or similar) to acquisition
  • Is strong in Sheets/Excel and comfortable with Northbeam and post-purchase survey tools (KnoCommerce). SQL/BigQuery is a plus

Approach to the role:

  • Measurement first: causal over correlational, skeptical of platform-reported numbers, and quick to push back on speculation
  • An owner who makes scale/cut calls with conviction and defends them with data
  • Treats partners as an extension of the team and holds them accountable, but never outsources the thinking
  • Comfortable with long feedback loops, and knows the difference between a brand bet and a failed test
  • A clear, concise communicator who can present to the CMO and VP of Growth and make our creative better
  • A full-funnel thinker who connects reach media to lower-funnel efficiency and brings non-traditional ideas

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $140,000 – $160,000 plus bonus depending on experience. Beyond base salary, we offer competitive equity packages and a comprehensive set of benefits designed to support the well-being, growth, and balance of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

raw.title: AI Voice Evaluation Specialist
raw.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
raw.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

We are looking for detail-oriented Voice Specialists to evaluate the performance of AI models through real-time, voice-based conversations. In this role, you will interact with two different AI models using the same assigned scenario, carefully compare their responses, and provide structured evaluations based on defined quality criteria.

The goal of the evaluation is to create a fair, consistent comparison between models and identify which model delivers the stronger overall conversational experience.

What You’ll Own:

  • Review an assigned scenario and roleplay a natural conversation with two different AI models.
  • Conduct comparable conversations with Model A and Model B, keeping the scenario, conversational approach, and overall interaction as consistent as possible.
  • Maintain approximately the same number of conversational turns with each model to support a fair comparison.
  • Record your voice during each interaction and pay close attention to the quality and behavior of the model's responses.
  • Evaluate each model across five defined evaluation dimensions.
  • Identify and categorize relevant error clusters that may occur in the audio or conversation.
  • Compare the performance of Model A and Model B based on the evaluation criteria and your observations.
  • Select the model that demonstrated the stronger overall performance according to the defined evaluation framework.
  • Write a detailed rationale explaining your final preference, referencing specific examples and observations from both conversations.
  • Apply evaluation guidelines consistently across different scenarios and model interactions

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have

  • Bachelors Degree
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to notice subtle differences in conversational quality.
  • Excellent listening and comprehension skills.
  • Strong written communication skills, particularly the ability to explain observations clearly and objectively.
  • Ability to follow detailed evaluation guidelines consistently.
  • Comfort speaking naturally and roleplaying different conversational scenarios.
  • Ability to compare two interactions fairly without allowing personal preferences to influence the evaluation.
  • Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills.
  • Reliability and consistency when completing structured evaluation tasks.
  • Familiarity with AI assistants, voice-based AI, or conversational systems

The expected hourly salary range for this position is $20-$27 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

raw.description:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

About Lygos:

We're Lygos, the team building the next new standard for Bitcoin collateral. Our mission is to unlock secure, transparent, and verifiable Bitcoin-backed credit markets.

We’re starting by developing a fundamentally new platform for Bitcoin-collateralized lending, leveraging Discreet Log Contracts (DLCs) to minimize counterparty risk and ensure borrowers maintain control of their Bitcoin.

Our founding team brings deep expertise from Anchorage Digital, StarkWare, ConsenSys, Shopify, and JPMorgan, backed by industry-leading investors, including Initialized and ConsenSys.

We’re an agile, highly motivated team seeking passionate builders ready to shape the future of Bitcoin finance.

The Opportunity:

As a Founding Full-Stack Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and building the Lygos platform and stack. It's a chance to be a core part of a foundational team, contribute to key architectural decisions, and grow with a company offering generous equity for early team members. You'll work directly with our experienced CTO and founding team to bring our innovative Bitcoin-native financial products to life.

Job Type:

  • Full-time, permanent role.

  • Fully remote opportunity with flexible hours.

  • (Optional: Office space available in Toronto for those who prefer hybrid work.)

What You'll Do:

  • Build & Innovate: Design, develop, and deploy core features for the Lygos platform, spanning our backend services, oracle infrastructure, and borrower-facing applications.

  • Full-Stack Development: Work across our entire stack, including TypeScript/Node.js backend services, database management (SQL/NoSQL), and potentially contributing to our React Native mobile application.

  • Bitcoin & DLC Integration: Implement and enhance functionality related to Bitcoin transactions, PSBTs, and the integration of Discreet Log Contracts. You'll be working with cutting-edge Bitcoin contract technology.

  • Oracle & Watchtower Systems: Contribute to the development and maintenance of our oracle systems for price attestations and event monitoring, as well as related infrastructure like watchtowers and notification services.

  • Architectural Input: Collaborate on platform architecture discussions, helping to design scalable, secure, and robust systems.

  • Embrace the Challenge: Be ready to wear multiple hats, tackle diverse challenges, learn quickly, and contribute proactively in a fast-paced environment.

What We're Looking For (Requirements):

  • Hungry & Motivated: You are driven, proactive, and excited by the challenge of building something impactful from the ground up in a small, fast-moving team.

  • Strong TypeScript & Node.js Experience: Proven ability to build robust backend services.

  • Full-Stack Versatility: Comfortable working on both backend logic and potentially contributing to frontend components.

  • Database Proficiency: Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

  • Independent & Proactive: Ability to work independently, take ownership, and figure things out with minimal oversight.

  • Quick Learner: Eagerness and ability to dive into an existing codebase and rapidly learn new technologies and concepts, especially around DLCs.

  • Excellent Communicator & Team Player: You thrive in a collaborative environment.

Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points):

  • Direct experience with Bitcoin development and advanced scripting.

  • Good technical grasp of Bitcoin's blockchain architecture, the UTXO model, transactions, and ideally some familiarity with Bitcoin libraries (e.g., bitcoinjs-lib, working with PSBTs).

  • Knowledge of Discreet Log Contracts (DLCs) or other advanced Bitcoin contract types (big plus, but we will provide resources and training if you have a strong Bitcoin foundation).

  • Experience with blockchain oracles or multi-signature setups.

  • React Native experience.

  • Familiarity with Rust or C++ (relevant to Bitcoin/DLC libraries).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience at an early stage startup.

Why Join Lygos?

  • Founding Team Impact: As our first engineering hire, you'll have a direct, significant impact on the product, technology, and company culture.

  • Generous Equity: We believe in aligning incentives and are offering a substantial equity stake for early, key team members. Your success is our success.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer highly competitive salaries to attract and retain the best talent in the industry.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology: Work at the forefront of Bitcoin innovation with Discreet Log Contracts.

  • Experienced Leadership: Learn from and collaborate with a founding team that has deep expertise in both institutional finance and pioneering DLC technology.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: Help build a foundational layer for the future of Bitcoin finance.

  • Remote & Flexible: Enjoy the benefits of a fully remote setup, with opportunities to collaborate in-person

Our Typical Interview Process

  • Initial Application. Fill out the short form so we can get to know you!

  • 1-2 chats. Discuss our vision, check for culture fit, talk about your past experience, get to know each other more in-depth. Feel free to ask us questions as well!

  • Complete a paid take-home assignment. We’ll have you work on a small project relevant to our infrastructure that we’ll review.

  • 2-way reference check. You chat with our investors and team members. We chat with previous (or current) coworkers/managers.

  • Offer.

Ready to build the future of Bitcoin finance with us? Apply now and we'll get back to you as soon as we can!

raw.description:
About the company

Our client is a lean, founder-led venture-building studio and family office running a portfolio of businesses across events, hospitality, luxury consumer, media, and investments. The company is building AI-first operating systems so a small team can run multiple businesses at once — removing repetitive admin, improving decision-making, and keeping headcount deliberately low.

Why this role exists

The studio needs one hands-on technical owner for AI and automation across the whole portfolio. Some automations already exist; the mandate is to take them over, rebuild what needs rebuilding, and own a clean, maintainable stack end to end. There is no technical manager above you — you work directly with the founder and the commercial lead, and the architecture decisions are yours.

This is a builder role — the person ships working systems the business actually uses — reliable agents and automations that hold up in production.

What you'll work on

AI development & automation — 80%

  • AI research agents: vendors, sponsors, guests, brands, venues, market opportunities
  • Screening and scoring systems that combine scraped data with hard metrics and business criteria
  • Inbox triage, summarisation, and routing; multi-inbox monitoring with decision-ready daily summaries
  • Systems that turn unstructured founder inputs (screenshots, voice notes, links) into recommendations and routed tasks
  • CRM and outreach workflows, dashboards and trackers, calendar and recurring-task automations

No one has built all of this — what matters is a track record with comparable use cases and the ability to transfer it to new problem types. Expect a fast cadence: first automation live within 30 days, several production workflows by 60–90 days.

Technical generalist — 20% (~1 day/week)

  • Keep the operational stack running: Notion (incl. Notion AI), Google Workspace, HubSpot, access management, integrations, troubleshooting, data cleanup

Requirements

  • Shipped production automations or AI-powered tools in a real business context — not side projects, demos, or hackathon builds
  • Practical fluency with LLMs, APIs, and at least one automation platform (Make, n8n, Zapier, or similar)
  • Python or equivalent scripting ability — many builds are achievable low-code, but candidates who can write and debug their own scripts have a higher ceiling
  • Experience with vector search, RAG, agent frameworks, function calling, and workflow orchestration
  • Ability to design workflows with human approval points, exception handling, logging, and error recovery — systems that fail gracefully and visibly, not silently
  • Strong documentation habits — your systems must be maintainable and understandable by non-technical colleagues
  • Comfort with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and working independently without full specs or a technical escalation path
  • English sufficient for daily written and spoken communication (B2+)

Nice to have

  • Experience building internal tools for executives, family offices, venture studios, agencies, or lean startups
  • HubSpot or comparable CRM experience

Location requirements

  • Fully remote, but your working day must overlap with UK time (GMT/BST) for 6–8 hours daily
  • An additional ~2-hour overlap with Malaysia time (GMT+8) is a plus

What to expect

  • Greenfield mandate: build and own the AI stack; genuine autonomy, no stakeholder committees
  • Cross-portfolio ownership — your systems run real businesses across events, media, luxury, and investments
  • Direct access to the founder from day one; radically lean process: a call a decision execution
  • An expanding role: new ventures continuously add projects, with the prospect of support hires under you as the stack grows

Interview process

  1. Recruiter screen (incl. a short portfolio example of an automation you built)
  2. Interview with the client
  3. Practical assessment
  4. Final interview with the founder

Terms

  • Remote-first contractor engagement; own equipment required
  • 28 days PTO per year, taken freely — covers vacation, sick leave, and holidays in a single policy
  • Business travel expenses covered when required

As Xanadu's Technical Engagement Manager (TEM), U.S. Government, you will drive the growth and delivery of our U.S. government-funded research portfolio, owning the full lifecycle from identifying and winning new funding to assuring successful execution of active awards. This includes building relationships, shaping opportunities, and ensuring that our government funded programs remain on track and strategically aligned with both Xanadu’s technical roadmap and funding agency priorities. You will serve as the primary interface between Xanadu and U.S. government research funding communities. As such, an ideal candidate will feel comfortable bridging the divide between U.S. government needs and Xanadu’s technical capabilities and expertise.

You Will:
  • Manage delivery on a wide range of active U.S. government grants, working closely with principal investigators and technical staff to ensure timely delivery of milestones, reports, and deliverables across active awards.
  • Coordinate with Xanadu’s Hardware, Software, Algorithms, Legal, and Finance teams to ensure proposals are technically rigorous, strategically compelling, and administratively compliant.
  • Lead outreach and grant-writing efforts for new U.S. government funding opportunities, including shaping strategy, assembling teaming arrangements with primes and national labs, writing and editing technical volumes, and managing proposal submissions.
  • Cultivate and expand relationships with U.S. government program managers, prime contractors, national lab collaborators, and other key community stakeholders, to position Xanadu for upcoming solicitations and opportunities.
  • Monitor the funding landscape and proactively brief leadership on programs aligned with Xanadu's research roadmap in fault-tolerant quantum computing, photonic hardware, and quantum algorithms.
  • Represent Xanadu at community events and use these engagements to generate new leads and teaming partnerships.

Basic qualifications and experience:
  • Undergraduate degree in physics, chemistry, computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in a government-facing technical or program management role (e.g., program manager or SETA, national laboratory researcher, defense contractor, FFRDC staff, or university research/program administrator).
  • Direct experience writing, reviewing, or managing proposals for U.S. government funding programs.
  • Track record of successfully identifying, winning, and/or managing new government-funded programs or contracts.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. government contracting and grants processes, including compliance requirements, cost accounting standards, and reporting obligations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate deep technical content into compelling proposal narratives.
  • U.S. citizen or permanent resident.

Preferred qualifications and experience:
  • Advanced degree (PhD, MSc, or equivalent) in physics, chemistry, computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Familiarity with quantum computing, photonics, superconducting systems, or adjacent deep-tech domains.
  • Existing relationships with program managers at DARPA, DoE, or national laboratories.
  • Experience working with or within a startup or high-growth technology company.
  • Familiarity with the U.S. public policy landscape as it relates to emerging technologies, including congressional affairs, executive branch science and technology priorities, and the federal budget and appropriations process.
  • Active U.S. security clearance (Secret or above), or clearance eligibility.

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Rare Disease is a field-based scientific expert and a key scientific resource for clinicians, academic institutions, and professional organizations in the Rare Disease community. This individual builds relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), leads scientific exchange on Natera's Rare Disease test, and brings field insights back to Rare Disease leadership. The MSL works closely with the Rare Disease Sales, Marketing, and Medical teams to help bring the test to more patients. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and reports to the Director of MSLs, Rare Disease.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide scientific and clinical presentations on Natera products, with a focus on Rare Disease, and respond to customer requests for information about marketed and developing products.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage relationships with KOLs from the Rare Disease community and other relevant healthcare professionals.
  • Capture field insights on clinical practice, unmet needs, and market dynamics, and share them with Rare Disease leadership.
  • Serve as a medical and scientific resource for the Natera Sales and Marketing teams, and collaborate with Marketing to develop educational materials for healthcare providers and patients.
  • Participate in clinical research, data analysis, and scientific writing.

  • Master's degree required, or a doctorate (PharmD, PhD, MD/DO, DNP), in a clinical or scientific field with relevant knowledge of Rare Disease.

  • Experience with the introduction of new clinical laboratory tests preferred.
  • Must pass a post-offer criminal background check.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Technical:

  • Knowledge of Rare Disease and relevant clinical sciences, with the ability to explain clinical laboratory test data to clinicians.
  • Proficiency with user databases, Google Sheets, and Salesforce, including systems that contain PHI.

Behavioral:

  • Data Ingestion: Design and build the pipelines that bring data in for feature engineering and machine learning.

  • Experience: 6+ years working across data science and machine learning (for the Lead level).

  • Data Types: Hands-on work with both structured and unstructured data, such as tables, text, images, and video.

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are looking for Developer Productivity Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use.

Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively.

  • Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on.

  • Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers.

  • Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring.

  • Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably.

  • Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs.

Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them.

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and skills.

  • Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review.

  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures.

  • A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior.

  • Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

Innodata is building a team of Prompt Engineers to leverage large language models (LLMs) to automate and optimize data annotation and human evaluation workflows. In this role, you will design and implement effective prompt strategies that improve accuracy, localization, and cultural alignment in data labeling and translation processes.

Working closely with Product, Data Science, Operations, and client stakeholders, you will translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions. You will identify automation opportunities, develop prompt-based workflows, and continuously measure and refine performance to ensure high standards of quality and reliability.
