raw.excerpt: About AlphaSense: The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making.
raw.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and reliability of our global financial data extraction and normalization platform. This system ingests filings across formats (HTML, PDF, APIs, spreadsheets), extracts and standardizes financial data using a combination of AI and deterministic systems, and delivers trusted, traceable outputs at scale to downstream financial services teams and customers.

This role owns the self-sourcing and extraction foundation used by multiple teams across the organization. Today, human validation is used as a safety net. Your mission is to systematically reduce human dependency by increasing system correctness, confidence, and trust, without sacrificing speed or scalability.

You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, AI-driven extraction, data quality, and platform architecture, raising the technical bar and reshaping how we build reliable systems.

Who You Are:

  • 15+ years of experience building and operating large-scale production systems
  • Proven experience designing data ingestion, extraction, or processing systems at scale
  • Deep expertise in one or more of:
    • Distributed systems
    • Data platforms and pipelines
    • AI/ML-powered extraction or classification systems
    • Platform or infrastructure engineering
  • Demonstrated ability to design trustworthy systems that combine probabilistic (AI) and deterministic approaches
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, failure modes, and iterative hardening
  • Experience reducing operational or human overhead through better system design
  • Track record of technical leadership across teams without formal people management
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity where none exists
  • Passion for using AI responsibly and effectively to deliver scalable, high-confidence systems
  • Nice to Have
    • Experience with document understanding, NLP, or financial data extraction
    • Experience building provenance, lineage, or confidence-scoring systems
    • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and modern data stacks
    • Experience shaping or owning internal platforms used by multiple teams

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the architecture and evolution of our large-scale data extraction and normalization platform
  • Design systems that process hundreds of thousands of records across heterogeneous sources (PDF, HTML, APIs, XLS) with high reliability
  • Define and implement strategies to minimize human-in-the-loop validation through AI-based validation, confidence scoring, provenance tracking, and deterministic safeguards
  • Establish clear system contracts for correctness, traceability, and confidence (e.g., “where did this number come from?”)
  • Balance AI-driven approaches with procedural and rules-based systems where they improve reliability and explainabilityIdentify and remediate architectural and operational bottlenecks impacting scale, accuracy, and developer velocity
  • Act as the technical authority to block poor designs, redesign critical systems, and introduce new platforms or tooling when necessary
  • Partner with product and downstream consumers to define quality bars, SLAs, and success metrics
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for production issues, reliability failures, and systemic risks
  • Mentor senior engineers, shape technical culture, and raise expectations for system design and execution
  • Contribute to long-term technical strategy while remaining hands-on with critical implementations

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

Compensation Range
$246,000—$339,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

raw.description:
About PushPress
PushPress is the AI-powered gym management platform built for boutique fitness.

We are transforming how boutique fitness owners operate and how the entire $100B global fitness industry connects, transacts, and grows. Trusted by more than 5,000 gyms and 500,000 members, PushPress processes ~$1B annually.

We're a Series B company backed by Altos Ventures, StepStone, and Mucker Capital, and we're going all-in on AI. Our AI Assistant, AI Member Intel, and AI-powered reporting tools are already changing how gym owners and coaches operate. We believe AI should make the human side of fitness better, not replace it.

By embedding intelligence directly into the product, we enable boutique fitness owners to make faster decisions, unlock new revenue streams, and collaborate across a connected network. As more gyms join the platform, data compounds, intelligence strengthens, and the value of the ecosystem increases for every owner

We are a global team of builders, operators, and fitness fanatics on a mission to level the playing field for independent fitness entrepreneurs. If you are ready to help reshape an industry, let's talk!

The Role

We're looking for a Customer Success Specialist to own the full client lifecycle for Grow, PushPress's CRM and marketing automation add-on built on GoHighLevel (GHL).

Like our Technical Support Specialists, you're methodical with systems and precise under escalation. Like our Onboarding Specialists, you teach, coach, and carry a client through a real lifecycle rather than a single ticket. You bring both together for one product: helping clients set up and adopt Grow through our paid White Glove onboarding service, stepping in when a Grow account is at risk of churning, and owning technical Grow escalations in the support queue.

This role requires genuine CRM fluency. You should be comfortable inside GHL's workflow builder, automations, and integrations the way a technical support engineer is comfortable inside a codebase.

What You'll Own

    White Glove Onboarding

  • Serve as the onboarding contact for clients who purchase White Glove, PushPress's paid, done-for-you Grow setup service
  • Host live Initial and Follow-up onboarding calls focused on hands-on CRM setup: workflow builds, automations, website/CRM forms, and A2P/SMS configuration
  • Track client progress toward setup milestones, follow up on stalls, and ensure delivery lands within the committed window
  • Customize the build to each client's goals and business model rather than applying a generic template
  • Document scope, findings, and delivery notes so the engagement is auditable end to end

    • Grow Retention

  • Take retention calls with Grow clients at risk of canceling and walk them through a tier or configuration change that keeps the account
  • Own the technical side of any downgrade or reconfiguration: plan changes and automation audits
  • Track save outcomes for accurate retention reporting

    • Technical Grow Support

  • Own escalated Grow tickets in the support queue that require real CRM depth: broken automations, integration failures, and A2P/SMS issues
  • Validate and reproduce technical issues before escalating further
  • Act as the internal subject matter expert on Grow/GHL behavior for the support and onboarding teams
  • Maintain documentation on common Grow issues, fixes, and edge cases
  • Surface recurring product gaps and friction patterns to CX and Product with evidence

What We're Looking For

  • 2-3+ years in a technical support, implementation, or customer success role in SaaS
  • Direct experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM/marketing automation platform required
  • Genuine CRM fluency: comfortable inside workflow builders, automations, integrations, and A2P/SMS compliance
  • Strong communicator -- able to teach a client through a live setup call as easily as writing a clean technical escalation
  • Calm and clear in high-stakes retention conversations; can hold a difficult tradeoff without losing the relationship
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven; follows through on checklists and audits without being chased
  • Comfortable translating between non-technical customers and more technical internal teams
  • Comfortable utilizing AI to automate workflows and create leverage in your day-to-day

Nice to Have

  • Prior retention or high-stakes client conversation experience
  • Fitness industry or PushPress product experience
  • Experience with A2P/SMS compliance and carrier registration

Benefits & Perks

  • Equity Incentive Plan
  • Flexible Paid Time Off (and Public Holidays)
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (Company Sponsored 401k with Match)
  • Life Insurance
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Work From Home Stipend
  • Wellness Stipend

raw.description:
SmartyAds is expanding its Google MCM (Multiple Customer Management) business and looking for an experienced Publisher BD Manager to drive publisher acquisition and growth. You will be the key person responsible for identifying, pitching, and onboarding quality publishers — with a strong focus on in-app and CTV inventory — and ensuring they succeed within the SmartyAds MCM ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, pitch, and onboard publishers to the SmartyAds MCM account, ensuring a smooth and technically sound integration process from contract to first impression
  • Focus on acquiring in-app and CTV publishers as primary inventory targets, while also developing relationships across web, news, gaming, entertainment, and finance verticals
  • Guide publishers through the Google Ad Manager delegated account setup, policy compliance requirements, and initial inventory configuration
  • Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with publishers, with a focus on inventory monetization, yield optimisation, and fill rate improvement
  • Develop and execute outbound strategies to grow the publisher base — cold outreach, industry events, partner referrals, and inbound qualification
  • Monitor publisher performance post-onboarding and proactively identify opportunities for inventory growth or issue resolution in cooperation with Publisher Relations Manager
  • Collaborate with Tech team to resolve integration issues and ensure publishers are set up for success
  • Stay current on Google MCM policy updates, AdX eligibility requirements, and programmatic market trends relevant to publisher monetization
  • Report on pipeline progress, onboarding metrics, and publisher revenue contribution to leadership

Requirements

Must Have

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, publisher acquisition, or partnerships within the AdTech ecosystem
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience working with Google MCM (Multiple Customer Management) — including delegated account setup, publisher onboarding, and policy compliance
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Ad Manager (GAM) — ad unit configuration, inventory types, targeting, and reporting
  • Proven track record of independently acquiring and growing relationships with mid-to-large publishers
  • Deep understanding of programmatic monetization: CPM dynamics, floor pricing, deals and SSP/AdX relationships
  • Existing network of digital publishers (web, app, or CTV) that can be leveraged immediately
  • Familiarity with Google AdX eligibility requirements and publisher policy enforcement
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills — able to present technical monetization solutions to non-technical publisher stakeholders
  • Self-starter with the ability to manage a pipeline independently and hit acquisition targets with minimal supervision

Nice to Have

  • Experience specifically with in-app (SDK or S2S) and CTV publisher integrations
  • Familiarity with yield optimisation tools (Prebid, open bidding, mediation platforms)
  • Knowledge of global and regional AdTech market trends, particularly in markets where SmartyAds operates
  • Experience with outreach and CRM tools (HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
  • Understanding of privacy compliance requirements affecting publisher monetization (GDPR, COPPA, TCF)

raw.description:
Who We Are

Scratch Financial (“Scratch”) is a late stage venture-backed financial technology business based in Pasadena, California. At Scratch, everything starts and ends with our mission: being the payment partner of choice for veterinary practices and helping pet parents access the care their animals need without financial barriers. Driven by our award-winning technology, Scratch has become the fastest growing financing provider in veterinary care, with a partner network of 15,000+ practices across the U.S. and Canada.

Scratch has 2 main products:

  • Scratch Pay: Point-of-sale client facing lending, including a BNPL offering and longer-term payment plans
  • Scratch Checkout: Payment processing that is integrated with the veterinary practice management software

We are a company built on the foundation of transforming the way pet healthcare payments are done, and we are looking for innovators who share our commitment to shaping the future of veterinary care financing. If putting compassion first, helping tell the story of groundbreaking products and continuously learning & refining to achieve exceptional outcomes sounds like you, then we encourage you to apply.

Position Overview

In the four years since launching, payment processing has evolved from our first customer to serving many of the industry’s largest, most sophisticated and most demanding hospital networks. With Scratch now providing payment services to thousands of enterprise locations, we are looking for a leader to share the benefit of Scratch across new partners, and to provide consultative services to our current partner as they look to maximize the benefit of our technology.

The Director of Strategic Partnerships will be responsible for driving enterprise-level revenue growth across Scratch’s ecosystem. This role focuses on expanding adoption of Scratch Checkout within our existing Scratch Pay provider base, unlocking new enterprise partnerships, and leading the sales and go-to-market motion for emerging initiatives such as Scratch Rebates. You will develop and manage deep relationships with large veterinary groups, providing consultative partnership through the sales cycle, cross-functional implementations, and internal advocacy as those relationships scale.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable hunting for new enterprise opportunities, nurturing complex relationships, influencing executives, and mobilizing internal teams to deliver value for customers.

What You'll Do

  • Enterprise Sales & Revenue Growth
    • Own the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle for Scratch Checkout and future strategic products, from lead generation to negotiation and close.
    • Deepen adoption across large existing Scratch Pay partners through consultative, data-driven selling.
  • Strategic Account Management
    • Build and manage executive-level relationships within high-value accounts, serving as a trusted advisor on strategic and operational initiatives.
    • Conduct business reviews, performance analyses, and ROI discussions to secure expansion and retention
  • New Initiative Commercialization (e.g., Rebates)
    • Act as the commercial leader for new strategic initiatives like Scratch Rebates, driving early partner adoption, gathering feedback, and shaping product-market fit.
    • Partner with Product to influence feature development and ensure initiatives align with enterprise customer needs.
    • Build sales enablement materials, pricing frameworks, and scalable go-to-market strategies for new offerings.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of enterprise sales or strategic account management experience in tech (e.g., fintech, payments, SaaS), with a strong preference for candidates who have sold into veterinary corporate groups.
  • Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets and driving growth within long, complex sales cycles.
  • Deep experience selling into multi-location or enterprise organizations, with the ability to navigate matrixed structures and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong executive presence, with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, negotiate strategic agreements, and drive alignment across functions.
  • Expertise in consultative, data-driven selling, including conducting ROI analyses, performance reviews, and strategic business discussions that drive towards mutually aligned KPIs.
  • Experience managing large, high-value accounts, building long-term relationships, and driving expansion within existing customers.
  • Demonstrated success launching or commercializing new products, including shaping early GTM motions and gathering customer insights to inform product strategy.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Competitive base range of $175,000 - $200,000 and OTE of $220,000 - $240,000

Scratch is a remote-first company, giving ultimate flexibility to today's nomadic work style. For those who prefer a hybrid model, we do have an office space in Pasadena available for use (which is stocked with snacks & various beverages). We offer unlimited PTO, covered healthcare, 401k match, cell plan reimbursement, and monthly recognition opportunities. We also provide learning platforms and resources for all to keep growing. Not only that, but we have an equity retention policy to ensure you grow as the company grows financially, as well. And if your family is growing, we offer generous parental leave, too!

How to Apply

Ready to join our team? To apply, please visit our Scratch Careers Page. Be sure to:

  1. Submit your resume.
  2. Answer the custom questions provided.
  3. Feel free to add any additional information or documents you believe are relevant to your application.

We look forward to reviewing your application!

*Our team will ONLY contact you from the domain @scratchpay.com or @ats.rippling.com

Our Commitment

We’re innovators who care deeply about the lives of pets, their owners, and veterinary professionals. We believe diversity strengthens our team and drives better solutions.

Scratch is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Scratch considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

raw.title: Technical Program Manager
raw.excerpt: About us WEX is a global commerce platform that helps businesses solve operational complexities like employee benefits, managing and mobilizing fleets, and streamlining payments.
raw.description:
About us
WEX is a global commerce platform that helps businesses solve operational complexities like employee benefits, managing and mobilizing fleets, and streamlining payments.
With over 5,500 employees, we work with large and small companies in more than 200 countries and territories, and can tailor our services to meet the unique needs of their businesses.

About the Team

The Technical Program Management Office (TPMO) is a strategic function of the Technology Innovation & Strategic Operations (TISO) department within WEX. Our mission is to accelerate WEX’s product innovation velocity by optimizing how we deliver technology.
As part of the TPMO, you will work closely with Technology and Digital leadership to enable seamless execution of strategic priorities. We drive impact by aligning teams across departments, supporting proactive planning, risk mitigation, and cross-functional coordination to ensure successful delivery of critical initiatives. If you are passionate about systems thinking, innovation, and making technology delivery a competitive advantage, this team is for you.

​

About the opportunity
A Technical Program Manager is a key partner to the Technology leaders and their Digital leadership counterparts in driving end-to-end outcomes. You will be responsible for driving delivery on key initiatives within and across Technology Departments. As a Senior TPM at WEX, you will be responsible for enabling your teams and partners to plan, de-risk, and execute critical initiatives while reporting on progress, coordinating across technology teams, and ensuring project financial health. This role will focus primarily on a portfolio of work, and execution of projects within that, to enhance internal tooling and services for WEX employees.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Fluency: Demonstrate strong technical competency in relevant technologies and systems to effectively communicate with engineering teams, understand technical challenges, and make informed recommendations and escalations.

  • Program Planning/Continuous Planning: Based on Product and Technology leadership direction and priorities, facilitate ongoing planning sessions to adjust priorities and ensure continuous alignment with business goals within and across your portfolio. This will require close cross-functional partnership with technology team leaders, solution architects, and product partners. Ensure alignment of program increments with overall business goals and priorities. Encourage adaptive planning to respond to changing delivery and project requirements.

  • Program Management: Own and drive end-to-end technical implementation programs and workstreams focused on enhancements to internal tooling for WEX employees. Your work will be critical to creating operational efficiencies within the organization and to execute against several key strategic focus areas. You’ll create detailed work breakdowns, milestones, risks, success metrics, and deliverables for key initiatives in these areas, and execute multi-quarter roadmaps in partnership with engineering leadership. On an ongoing basis, plan, support and execute against a roadmap of enhancements to these systems, tools, and processes.

  • Execution Management: In support of the Tech Lead, monitor progress and recommend necessary adjustments to surface risks of program execution to key stakeholders in a targeted and timely way, with the goal of course correction. Facilitate these course corrections, as needed.

  • Stakeholder Management: Engage with stakeholders - Technology, Product, Solution Architecture, among others - at all levels to ensure visibility, provide updates, and address concerns. Facilitate communication between teams, ensuring transparency and alignment. Provide clear, consistent, and timely information flow and reports out on status.

  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies in partnership with accountable Tech and Product leaders. Monitor program risks and implement corrective actions as necessary. Escalate to senior leadership as appropriate.

  • Dependency Management: Identify, document, and manage dependencies across multiple projects, technologies, and teams. Proactively coordinate with stakeholders to ensure that dependencies are clearly understood, tracked, and addressed in a timely manner to minimize risks and avoid delays.

  • Tooling and Data Hygiene: Accordingly, ensure the use of standard project management tools - ideally within the Atlassian suite - and maintain high standards of data hygiene to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity. Avoid duplication of administrative effort. As a part of Jira stewardship, support accurate and transparent reporting and on-target capitalization within the organization through reporting and partnership.

  • Delivery and Outcome Tracking: Track program performance against the committed plan and goals. Use data and metrics to drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Education: BS/BA Degree in technical/information science or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience: Strong experience in technical program management overseeing key projects with high visibility to internal or external customers, with a high degree of complexity and inter-dependent work.

    • An ideal candidate blends technical acumen with strong program management skills to drive execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, bring structure and clarity to fast-paced environments, and excel at scaling cross-functional programs. With a deep understanding of the requirements of an Enterprise-wide effort, they are passionate about implementing solutions with lasting value for the company, and in service to that, developing plans and communicating effectively with senior stakeholders.

Technical Skills:

  • Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including hands-on experience with various phases, and ability to work closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineers, security, database administrators, and architects to help ensure alignment with best practices.

  • Solid understanding of, and detailed experience with, common internal organizational tools for email, chat, work management, project management, product ideation, continuous integration and delivery of software, and workspace management.

  • Strong familiarity with technologies and processes associated with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Experience driving highly technical transformation initiatives that represent new ways of working for cross-functional teams in various areas and disciplines.

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least one Agile methodology (e.g., Scrum).

    • Leadership and Communication: Proactive leadership, and confidence to drive results. Proven ability to motivate cross-functional teams. Model close partnership, with an emphasis on execution, collaboration, and empowerment. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

    • Problem-Solving: Ability to anticipate risks and effectively mitigate them. If risks then become issues, solve these complex problems efficiently in partnership with Digital and Technology leadership. Analytical mindset with strong decision-making capabilities.

​

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications: Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Agile Certified Practitioner).

  • Previous experience in FinTech or highly regulated environments.

  • Hands-on familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, Google Drive, etc.

raw.description:
OXOIX — це простір для розвитку та реалізації найсміливіших ідей в Entertainment напрямку! Ми надаємо сервісні рішення для брендів, які охоплюють міжнародні ринки.


Довіра, відкриті і конструктивні діалоги, командний результат — наші принципи, які лежать в основі всього, що ми створюємо разом.

Запрошуємо тебе масштабувати свій досвід і експертизу разом з нами!


Зараз ми шукаємо Middle Affiliate Manager, який(-а) підхопить сформований партнерський портфель, розвиватиме нові партнерства, підтримуватиме структуру у роботі з афіліатами і допоможе команді впевнено масштабуватись на Tier-1 ринках.

Твоя роль складатиметься з

  • Побудови та управління власним портфелем affiliate-партнерів (Tier-1 пріоритетно);

  • Залучення та онбордингу SEO, PPC, SMS/Email партнерів;

  • Ведення переговорів та оптимізації угод для підвищення ROI та доходу;

  • Аналізу кампаній, моніторингу ефективності трафіку та коригування стратегії;

  • Роботи з цифрами та бюджетами, підготовки регулярних KPI-звітів;

  • Масштабування партнерських відносин та досягнення цільових KPI;

  • Моніторингу та перевірки виплат партнерам;

  • Співпраці з брендом, аналітикою та платіжними системами;

  • Участі у профільних конференціях для розвитку партнерської мережі.

Ми очікуємо від тебе

  • Досвід роботи Affiliate Manager від 1, 5 рокy (IGaming);

  • Досвід роботи з Tier-1 GEO (DE, AU, NZ, NL, UK тощо);

  • Розуміння моделей CPA, RevShare, Hybrid;

  • Досвід роботи з трекінговими платформами (Affilka, Referron: налаштування постбеків);

  • Навички аналізу трафіку та роботи з метриками (FTD, LTV, ROI);

  • Досвід ведення переговорів і побудови довгострокових партнерств;

  • Англійська мова на рівні не нижче Intermediate;

  • Самостійність, проактивність, орієнтація на результат.

Буде плюсом

  • Наявність власної бази афіліатів;

  • Досвід роботи з SEO, PPC, Email;

  • Розуміння антифрод-практик в iGaming.

Наші Selling Points

  • Multi-brand portfolio: працюєш одразу з кількома брендами, а не одним.

  • Лояльність до нових сорсів: відкриті до нових джерел трафіку, підтримуємо експерименти.

  • 3 моделі виплат: CPA, RevShare та Hybrid для гнучкої роботи з будь-яким типом партнерів.

  • Мультиплатформність: досвід роботи з кількома платформами одночасно.

  • Можливість зростання до Senior за 6 місяців: чіткий грейдинг і реальний кар'єрний трек вже в перше півріччя.

  • AI-інструменти в роботі: використовуємо AI для аналітики, комунікацій та автоматизації процесів.

Твої цілі на випробувальний термін

  • Пошук нових партнерів та їх адаптація відповідно до платформи.

  • Формування актуального списку партнерів, з якими ведеться робота.

  • Ініціювання крос-командної комунікації щодо поточних питань та ініціація бонусних механік для партнерів із просіданням конверсії.

  • Виконання KPI по FTD та залученню нових партнерів (встановлюються індивідуально).

Як виглядає рекрутинг процес на цю позицію ⤵️

  • Інтерв’ю з рекрутером 30- 45 хвилин.

  • Технічне Інтерв'ю з Hiring manager - 60 хвилин. Поговоримо про твій досвід роботи з партнерами, трафіком, метриками та вміння аналізувати показники.

  • Фінальне інтевʼю з CMO - 45 хвилин - під час цього інтерв’ю ми поговоримо про реальні кейси з твого досвіду та перевіримо необхідні компетенції на цю роль.

  • Збір рекомендацій та background check.

  • Оffer.

Що ми пропонуємо


🏆 Топові бренди - працюємо з сучасними рішеннями, які довели свою ефективність і стабільно приносять високі результати на своїх ГЕО.


🌍 Гнучкий формат - можливість обрати ремоут чи відвідувати коворкінг у Києві.


🌴 Відпочинок. 20 робочих днів щорічно + 5 retreat days, вихідні на державні свята.

💜 Wellness - страхування або компенсація за медичні послуги.

⚡ AI Champion - можливість стати частиною команди по впровадженню AI та автоматизацій на рівні компанії

Хочеш стати частиною команди? Тоді чекаємо на твій відгук!

Уся необхідна та повна інформація про обробку Ваших персональних даних надана компанії OXOIX у повному обсязі, у простій та зрозумілій формі. Надсилаючи своє резюме та інформацію, зазначену в анкеті, Ви надаєте згоду на обробку Ваших персональних даних на умовах, викладених у Згоді на обробку персональних даних.

  • Координація: управління календарем команди, фіксація рішень і контроль рішень та домовленостей.

Вимоги до кандидата:

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:

  • Повноцінне навчання та занурення у специфіку роботи.
  • Заробітну плату, що складається зі ставки і бонусів, виплата в $.
  • Кар'єрний ріст завдяки високим результатам роботи.

About Truegenics

Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading e-commerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialize in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience.
We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and we are committed to creating products that enhance the lives of our consumers.

Why This Role Matters

We are looking for a Senior Graphic & Web Designer who is passionate about creating meaningful brand experiences. Someone who combines creativity with technical precision and takes full ownership of their work.
You will be the visual voice of our brands, shaping how our products look, feel, and perform across packaging and web experiences. This is a fully remote role, so clear communication, strong collaboration, and accountability are key to your success.
You will partner closely with the marketing, copywriting, and sales teams to create designs that not only look exceptional but also deliver measurable results, driving conversions, strengthening brand reputation, and deepening customer loyalty.

Mission of the Role

To elevate Truegenics’ visual identity across all touchpoints by ensuring every design supports business objectives, reinforces brand integrity, and resonates with our target audience.
As a senior creative, you will lead by example, maintaining design excellence, guiding junior team members, and setting high standards for creativity, performance, and consistency across all brands.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic & Packaging Design (30%)

  • Conceptualize and execute creative ideas for digital and packaging projects based on brand direction, marketing briefs, and customer experience principles.
  • Design and adapt packaging across product lines using established brand templates, ensuring consistency while introducing fresh variations for new launches.
  • Create digital design assets for websites, social media, emails, and campaigns that engage users and drive conversions.
  • Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity across all design outputs, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
  • Develop and evolve key brand visuals including logos, icons, color systems, typography, and layout frameworks.
  • Translate marketing strategies into visually compelling campaigns that strengthen brand equity and support sales growth.
  • Mentor and guide junior designers, providing clear feedback and creative direction to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Research and incorporate emerging design trends, creative formats, and audience insights to keep the brand relevant and competitive.

Web Design & Frontend Development (70%)

  • Design and develop responsive, high-performing web pages with a strong mobile-first approach, ensuring layouts, navigation, and performance are optimized for mobile users.
  • Collaborate with marketing, media, and copywriting teams to design and optimize eCommerce landing pages that convert effectively across devices.
  • Apply UX/UI best practices to build layouts that are visually engaging, intuitive to navigate, and optimized for performance.
  • Develop reusable page templates and modular design systems to improve speed, consistency, and scalability.
  • Ensure all web assets meet quality standards for responsiveness, accessibility, and loading performance.
  • Coordinate the execution of promotional web materials, ensuring accuracy, brand consistency, and timely delivery.
  • Review and refine the work of junior designers, providing constructive feedback that enhances both creative quality and execution.

Key Requirements

  • Strong portfolio showcasing both digital and web design work. Clear examples of mobile-first design projects will be a plus.
  • Expertise in responsive and mobile UX/UI design, including optimizing layouts, images, and performance for smaller screens.
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline creative processes, generate ideas, or enhance productivity (for example, generating layout variations, assisting with copy, or automating production tasks).
  • Willingness to learn, explore, and adopt new AI tools to improve design quality and efficiency.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present ideas, feedback, and updates clearly in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Self-driven, highly organized, and accountable to deadlines.
  • Skilled in managing multiple projects while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable collaborating through digital tools and workflows such as Figma, Slack, and Wrike.

Working Arrangement

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates who can collaborate effectively across digital platforms and time zones.

The potential hire must also be equipped with the following to carry out this role effectively:

  • Laptop / CPU with acceptable speed
  • At least 1 monitor screen (inclusive of laptop screen)
  • Headset with Mic (Noise cancelling)
  • Webcam
  • Designated Workstation
  • Stable and strong power and internet connectivity
  • Noise-free and conducive environment

***This is a remote position. You may work from a remote home office location anywhere in the Eastern or Central US time zones***

Wolters Kluwer is a leading provider of innovative tax and accounting software solutions, dedicated to empowering individuals and businesses with tools that streamline financial management and enhance compliance. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional value to our clients through cutting-edge technology and unparalleled customer service.

As a Global Account Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining and growing Tax and Accounting’s largest Global customers in North America. You will be responsible for managing 4-8 customers, developing and executing comprehensive sales strategies, expanding our overall relationship and partnership within the firm. In this high visibility role, you will establish and maintain senior level relationships that aid in driving the partnership into the future. You will be accountable for all new business and retention activity and sales for Tax and Accounting’s software and research products and services for these customers. Additionally, you will also be responsible for interacting, influencing and updating senior executives within Tax and Accounting on status and progress of overall relationship with the firm. Specific job responsibilities are outlined below:

What You’ll Do

  • Customer Knowledge: Through partnership with the firm, establish and maintain a consistent knowledge of the customers' global goals and objectives, both short term and long term, linking these objectives to our product strategy and vision to help them in the present and future state of their firm.
  • Product Expertise: Maintain a deep understanding of our software solutions, features, and benefits, enabling effective communication and demonstration of value to potential customers.
  • Sales Strategy Development: Formulate and execute a comprehensive global sales strategy to achieve revenue targets for new business and retention and expand penetration in the tax and accounting sector for both software and research.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain relationships with senior executives in North America and globally (where appropriate) and decision-makers at key accounts, understanding their business needs and aligning our solutions to drive value. This will also include key senior executives within Tax and Accounting to ensure we are developing and maintaining strong, collaborative executive relationships between our company and the firm.
  • Competitive Awareness: Maintain constant awareness of the global competitive market, including all competitive products and services firms are using or evaluating to solve their business needs. This would include product functionality, pricing and global market positioning.
  • Account Planning: Through extensive knowledge of the firm, facilitate timely customer Account Planning sessions with both client and internal stakeholders to align on the vision of our partnership into the future.
  • Sales Presentation and Negotiation: Deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals, effectively communicating our value proposition, pricing and ROI. Effectively negotiate contracts and close deals that contribute to revenue growth, partnering closely with our product team, ensuring profitability. Collaborating on and co-creating contracts with our legal team ensuring compliance with company policies and practices.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with marketing, product development, and customer success teams to ensure alignment on messaging, product features, and client feedback.

Other duties:

  • Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor
  • Consistent and accurate forecasting of new business and retention
  • Ongoing and consistent salesforce.com compliance with pipeline management
  • Consistent communication with sales leadership
  • Attend key customer and industry conferences

What You bring

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; MBA preferred

Minimum Experience:

  • Experience: 12+ years of B2B sales or account management/client relationship management experience with a focus on Enterprise software solutions in a comparable role, including proven track record of exceeding sales targets in a global market. Prior sales of Tax & Accounting applications/software solutions is preferred
  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of financial regulations, tax compliance, and accounting practices. Ability to translate complex concepts into actionable business strategies.
  • Sales Skills: Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and communication skills. Demonstrated ability to build relationships and influence at all organizational levels.
  • Analytical Thinking: Proficient in using data to drive decision-making and assess market opportunities. Familiarity with CRM systems and sales analytics tools.
  • Global Perspective: Experience working in international markets, with an understanding of cultural nuances and varying business practices.

Other Knowledge, Skills, Abilities or Certifications:

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on building and sustaining relationships.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to client needs.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Project manages with a highly collaborative style, deadline sensitive high priority programs and deliverables with a team-focused attitude.
  • Team oriented, cooperative, and flexible. Demonstrated ability to collaboratively work with a wide range of people at all levels of the organization.
  • Proficiency with CRM software, client success platforms, and data analytics.

TRAVEL

  • Up to 50% annually for client visits, conferences and team meetings as required

Remote

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Compensation:

$137,900.00 - $246,350.00 USDThis role is eligible for Commission.

Compensation range listed is based on primary location of the position. Actual base salary offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skills, experience and actual hiring location. Your recruiter can share more information about the specific offer for the job location during the hiring process.

Additional Information:

Wolters Kluwer offers a wide variety of competitive benefits and programs to help meet your needs and balance your work and personal life, including but not limited to: Medical, Dental, & Vision Plans, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Commuter Benefits, Tuition Assistance Plan, Vacation and Sick Time, and Paid Parental Leave. Full details of our benefits are available upon request.

Business and Data Analyst

Role Purpose

The Business & Data Analyst will be responsible for building a single source of truth for organizational data by integrating financial and operational information across multiple business processes and systems. This role requires a techno-functional professional with strong understanding of finance and business processes, hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Business Central , and strong analytics capability using tools such as Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Excel, SQL, and related reporting platforms. The individual will work across Finance, business, operations and other functions to automate data flows, improve data quality and deliver meaningful management insights through modern analytics platforms such as Microsoft Power BI. The objective is to create a reliable, scalable, and insight-driven reporting environment that supports business performance and strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analytics & Reporting
• Build automated reporting layers that consolidate data from ERP, Excel, operational systems, sales systems and other relevant sources.

  • Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, report requirements, dashboard/reporting logic and data mapping documents
  • Develop data models using Power Query, DAX, SQL, and other appropriate tools to support accurate reporting and analysis.
  • Develop and maintain automated dashboards, KPI scorecards, and management reports using Power BI and related tools.
  • Support leadership reporting requirements through accurate and actionable analytics.

    ERP & Systems Enablement
    • Act as a techno-functional bridge between Finance, business users, IT, and external implementation/support partners for Microsoft Dynamics-related reporting and process improvement initiatives.
  • Work with Finance, IT, and business teams to improve data availability, reporting structures, and system utilization.
  • Customize, develop, and enhance reports, queries, and data extracts within Microsoft Dynamics to meet evolving business and management reporting requirements.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Dynamics data structures and ensure optimal utilization of ERP data for analytics and decision-making.
  • Design and maintain integrations between Microsoft Dynamics and Power BI to enable automated, reliable, and scalable reporting solutions.
  • Recommend and support Microsoft Dynamics enhancements, testing, process improvements, and reporting automation initiatives.

Data Governance & Process Improvement
• Establish reporting standards, data integration layer and data validation controls.
• Improve data quality and integrity across key business processes. Identify data inconsistencies and work with process owners to correct root causes at source.

  • Define common data definitions, KPI logic, report ownership, refresh frequency, validation rules, and data lineage for key management reports.
  • Drive automation and reporting efficiency improvements.

    Experience & Qualifications
  • 5–7 years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, ERP Reporting, Business Intelligence, Finance Systems, or Finance Transformation.
    • Demonstrated experience managing enterprise-wide data and management reporting solutions.
    • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Business Central and Power BI.
    • Good understanding of finance and business processes.
    • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders.

Technical Skills

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Business Central

• Power BI, Power Query, DAX

• Advanced Excel

  • SQL and database concepts
    • Data modelling and reporting automation

• KPI dashboard development and BI tools

Key Competencies

  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset

• Strong business acumen

  • Ability to connect system structure with data and business outcomes
    • Stakeholder management and communication skills
    • Process improvement and automation orientation

• High ownership and attention to detail

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.

raw.excerpt: JUICE is a performance marketing agency that has driven more than $2.
raw.description:
JUICE is a performance marketing agency that has driven more than $2.5 billion in client revenue for brands like L’Oréal, CBDistillery, Effy Jewelry, Bond Vet, and [solidcore]. Our average client stays with us for over three years, our teams are senior only, and we run on proprietary AI built by our parent company, ONAR. The agency wins consistently once we’re in the room. This role exists to get us into more rooms and to turn those conversations into signed clients.

This isn’t a seat where you build your own pipeline from a cold start. A dedicated BD operations lead runs targeting, outbound, and scheduling, and books qualified discovery calls onto your calendar. The CEO joins your largest closing calls. You own the number.

What you’ll do

  • Own new business revenue for JUICE: run discovery calls, shape the pitch to each brand, write and present proposals, negotiate, and close.

  • Sell monthly retainers to e-commerce and consumer brands, with a minimum engagement size we hold firm on. Quality matters as much as volume: your compensation includes a second-year component, so clients that stay make you money.

  • Work the pipeline our BD operations lead builds for you, and bring your own network on top of it.

  • Keep the pipeline honest: stages, values, and next steps current, reviewed in a weekly meeting with the ONAR leadership team (CEO, President, and Finance).

  • Feed what you hear in the market back into our targeting, our pitch, and our creative.

What good looks like

  • Roughly 20 held discovery calls a month, booked for you, converting to 8 proposals and 2 or more signed clients at or above our engagement floor.

  • A first close inside your first 90 days, with a compounding book from there.

Who you are

  • 5+ years selling agency retainers, ideally $5K to $25K per month, at a performance or digital marketing agency. You’ve carried a number and hit it.

  • A real network in e-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands, and the credibility to get a founder or CMO on the phone.

  • A discovery-led seller. You ask about margins, LTV, and channel mix before you ever show a deck.

A recoverable draw plus uncapped commission paid on collected revenue, including a trailing component in each client’s second year. On-target earnings are strong six figures with no ceiling; the economics reward sellers who sign clients that stay. Full structure shared early in the process.

Submit your resume and a short note answering one question: What’s the largest retainer you’ve ever sold, and how did you win it?

En Logicalis Spain buscamos incorporar un/a DevOps Engineer para formar parte de nuestro pool de servicios gestionados, participando en la operación, evolución y automatización de plataformas críticas basadas en contenedores y CI/CD.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia en gestión de plataformas Kubernetes, automatización y CI/CD, pero también con capacidad para liderar técnicamente, organizar prioridades, coordinarse con diferentes equipos y asumir ownership sobre los servicios.

La persona seleccionada trabajará en entornos híbridos, on-premise y cloud, asegurando la disponibilidad, estabilidad, seguridad y rendimiento de las plataformas, así como la mejora continua de los procesos de operación y despliegue.

Funciones del puesto:

  • Administrar, operar y evolucionar plataformas de contenedores como Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS y/o EKS

  • Diseñar y mantener procesos de automatización y operación Day 2, reduciendo tareas manuales y mejorando la eficiencia operativa

  • Automatizar infraestructura y configuración mediante Ansible, Helm y Terraform

  • Desarrollar scripts y herramientas de automatización utilizando Python y Shell Script

  • Diseñar, mantener y optimizar pipelines de CI/CD con herramientas como Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions y ArgoCD

  • Gestionar despliegues, upgrades, configuraciones, backups, troubleshooting y resolución de incidencias complejas

  • Monitorizar la salud, capacidad, rendimiento y disponibilidad de las plataformas

  • Analizar problemas de forma proactiva y participar en la definición de acciones preventivas y de mejora

  • Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de Desarrollo, Infraestructura, Seguridad y Operaciones

  • Participar en la definición y aplicación de estándares de operación, seguridad, automatización y documentación

  • Asumir un papel de referente técnico, ayudando a otros miembros del equipo y aportando criterio en la toma de decisiones

  • Participar en iniciativas de mejora continua y evolución tecnológica de las plataformas gestionadas

Conocimientos imprescindibles

  • Experiencia senior en DevOps, Platform Engineering o SRE, preferiblemente en entornos de servicios gestionados

  • Experiencia sólida administrando y operando Kubernetes y/o OpenShift en entornos productivos

  • Conocimientos avanzados de CI/CD y experiencia real con herramientas como Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD o similares

  • Experiencia con Git y metodologías de integración y despliegue continuo

  • Experiencia en automatización Day 2, gestión de configuraciones e infraestructura como código

  • Buen dominio de Ansible, Helm y Terraform

  • Capacidad de scripting y automatización con Python y/o Shell Script

  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos híbridos, on-premise y cloud

  • Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting de problemas complejos en plataformas distribuidas y contenerizadas

  • Buenas capacidades de comunicación, organización y trabajo con diferentes equipos

  • Mentalidad orientada a la automatización, mejora continua y calidad del servicio

Conocimientos deseables

  • Experiencia con soluciones de backup y recuperación para Kubernetes, como Velero o Kasten

  • Conocimientos de almacenamiento en plataformas de contenedores como ODF, Rook/Ceph, CSI, etc.

  • Experiencia con AWS, Microsoft Azure y/o Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

  • Experiencia con soluciones de monitorización y observabilidad como Prometheus y Grafana

  • Conocimientos de plataformas de logging como Elastic Stack / Elasticsearch

  • Conocimientos de seguridad aplicada a contenedores y plataformas Kubernetes

  • Experiencia en entornos de alta disponibilidad y producción 24x7

  • Experiencia previa en liderazgo técnico, coordinación de equipos o gestión de servicios

¿Qué ofrecemos en Logicalis Spain?

Logicalis Spain somos un grupo internacional con más de 20 años de experiencia en el sector IT, vinculados a proyectos y servicios de gran envergadura en Data Centers, Ciberseguridad y Analytics.

Overview

Customer Success Manager (Ireland - Remote)

Your AI strategy is only as strong as the data behind it. Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — trust Quest to solve their most critical challenges. From securing identities and modernizing platforms to preparing data for AI, we help enterprises unlock their full potential.

The Customer Success Organization focuses on our most strategic customers. As a Strategic Customer Success Manager at Quest, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring these customers realize maximum value from their investments through comprehensive adoption and value engagements. The CSM will manage a portfolio of accounts and lead engagement throughout the customer lifecycle—from deployment and adoption through value realization and renewal—ensuring satisfaction and long-term success.

You’ll leverage your expertise to guide customers through their journey, maintain consistent engagement, and ensure they achieve their goals and derive measurable value from Quest solutions. You’ll also surface Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) and coordinate with Account Management for follow-up. CSMs support renewal contracting processes and are expected to stay informed on Quest’s evolving product portfolio, demonstrating the ability to quickly learn and communicate the value of new offerings.

Above all, this role is accountable for retention—sustaining business growth and profitability by maximizing value, driving usage and adoption, supporting services, and reducing churn.

Responsibilities

  • Owns the customer relationship of a global or large-scale strategic account and actively manages the stakeholder relationship at all levels (i.e., executive, management, technical leaders) including strategic roadmap discussions
  • Develops and nurtures relationships and adjusts value and adoption messaging according to the levels and interests of customer stakeholders
  • Coaches peers on strategic approaches, provide mentorship for Enterprise CSMs to help them grow their knowledge and provide premium customer experience
  • Identifies and creates solutions to address Customer Success needs, improve effectiveness and efficiency, and delivery to or exceed key customer metrics.
  • Develops and maintains strategic Success Plans that align to value milestones and customer-defined business outcomes.
  • Partners with the customer to build a joint plan for success, maintaining a detailed understanding of the customer’s business to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction, engagement, and adoption of Quest technologies.
  • Monitors customer analytics and KPIs to reinforce the value of the customer solution, identify areas to improve customer experience, and optimize the solution.
  • Facilitates Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) in collaboration with Account Management, using the Success Plan and business case to demonstrate impact, value delivered, and opportunities for growth.
  • Delivers an outstanding customer experience to support our brand promise of delivering superior outcomes and to support and identify cross-sell and upsell of services and products.
  • Actively monitors customer engagement signals and sentiment; log risks and opportunities in CRM and trigger internal playbooks where applicable.
  • Supports collaboration across Sales, Support, Product, Renewals, and Professional Services to ensure continuity and strategic alignment.
  • Acts as an escalation point for high-impact customer issues when necessary, ensuring appropriate teams within Quest are engaged for quick resolution.
  • Works within the wider CSM team to implement scalable programs and process improvements to drive efficiency of internal customer success processes and improve customer experience.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in customer success, technical account management, sales engineering, or similar role responsible for driving customer success and product/service adoption.
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in customer management within platform management and security solutions, focusing on growth, adoption, retention, and issue resolution at both the business owner and senior executive levels.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into business value, and work with sales and marketing to promote value-driven solutions
  • Ability to manage executive relationships and discussions (VP/CxO)
  • Skilled in bringing in a SAE/AE/ISR to see through upsell opportunities, whilst maintaining executive overlay and ensuring a positive customer experience
  • Strong knowledge of Customer Success best practices, with experience in defining process and providing enablement programs to promote adoption in CS and across the company
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to establish milestones and keep success plans on task.
  • Adept at handling internal and external escalations.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate and foster positive business relationships, and comfortable facilitating change and being accountable for driving success with customers.
  • Experience in leading, adopting and driving change internally or externally.
  • Experience in identifying, translating and prioritizing customer issues and needs into business or solution requirements.
  • Demonstrated success as a trusted advisor to senior executives in large organizations and ability to build success plans.
  • An understanding of how organizations measure value realization and drive revenue. Experience in recurring revenue sales models and renewal processes is an advantage.
  • Fluency in English and German.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience in transformational Customer Success projects or experience where products shift from On-Premise to SaaS.
  • Previous Customer Success experience in a company with B2B Software.
  • Proficiency in customer success tools (e.g., Gainsight, Totango) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) to manage customer health, success plans, and engagement tracking. Experience with AI prompting and leveraging AI tools to streamline processes.
  • Fluency in Dutch would be an advantage.

In compliance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, the base salary for this role starts from EUR 62,560 annually. Actual base salary will vary based on experience, qualifications, and performance. This role is also eligible to participate in a commission plan, with commission governed by a formal corporate compensation plan. Benefits are offered on a country-by-country basis.

At Quest, your work makes an impact. You’ll help organizations get AI-ready while building your career with a truly global team of high-performing, passionate innovators.

Join us today: Careers | Quest

Quest is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind:

Quest is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Quest are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief, national, social, or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Quest will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Quest encourages applicants of all ages.

Come join us. For more information, visit us on the web at Quest Careers. Innovate. Collaborate. Grow.

raw.description:
Category: Financial Services

Location:



Atlas Advisors LLC is seeking a detail-oriented, hands-on Temporary Staff Accountant to assist our CFO with a specific, project-based accounting cleanup. Our current processes involve significant manual work and complex historical details. This role is strictly project-based and will conclude once the accounting backlog is fully resolved.

This is a junior-level role best suited for someone who is eager to dig into transactional details, untangle manual data, and support fundamental accounting tasks. The ideal candidate must have a solid grasp of basic P&L and Balance Sheet principles and a strong willingness to roll up their sleeves to solve operational backlogs.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting Backlog & Reconciliations

  • Assist the CFO in reviewing, matching, and reconciling historical general ledger accounts, focusing on Balance Sheet and P&L line items.

  • Research transactional discrepancies, missing documentation, and un-reconciled balances across manual spreadsheets and system logs.

  • Perform routine subledger-to-general ledger reconciliations (Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and bank accounts).

  • Key in, organize, and clean up historical accounting entries to bring financial records up to date.

General Accounting Operations

  • Support daily transactional processing as needed to keep current operations moving while clearing the backlog.

  • Enter, verify, and code vendor invoices, expense reports, and customer billing data.

  • Maintain organized digital audit trails and electronic filing for all reconciled transactions.

  • Gather supporting documentation for financial schedules and routine reporting as directed by the CFO.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Detail-Oriented & Hands-On:Absolute willingness to dive deep into granular transactional details, troubleshoot manual process errors, and work through complex spreadsheets.

  • Core Accounting Fundamentals:Solid understanding of basic accounting principles, general ledger structures, and how transactions impact the P&L and Balance Sheet.

  • Software & Excel Skills:Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, basic pivot tables, data sorting/filtering, and formula building).

  • Work Ethic & Focus:Ability to follow direction closely, work independently on repetitive or detailed tasks, and ask clarifying questions when encountering anomalies.

  • Role Understanding:Clear understanding that this is a temporary, contract-based position that will end when the backlog project is complete.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience:1–3 years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience.

  • Software Experience:Prior experience withDeltek Costpointis strongly preferred (experience with Unanet or other ERP systems is also a plus).

  • Industry Background:Previous exposure to government contracting environments is preferred, but not required.

  • Education:Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or coursework toward a degree (relevant practical experience will be considered in lieu of a degree).

​

Work Type

This is a temporary, project-based 1099 contract position. The contractor is guaranteed 20 hours per week, with the potential to scale up to 40 hours per week based on accounting backlog volume and business needs. This position is fully remote and will conclude once the accounting backlog has been resolved.

​

Contact assigned customer accounts or prospects to sell company products within a designated geography or industry. Focus on meeting personal sales targets, developing new business, maintaining customer relationships, and troubleshooting specific customer problems. Have solid knowledge of products, their characteristics, and the market. Typically requires excellent interpersonal skills and sales experience.

Job Description

Job Purpose

As an Away From Home (AFH) Field Sales Representative, you will be a key player in driving Kraft Heinz’s market share and profitability within your designated territory. This role goes beyond traditional sales—it’s about owning your business, selling solutions, and influencing stakeholders to drive success. We’re looking for a proactive, results-driven individual who can make an impact from day one by building relationships, developing sales strategies, and executing key initiatives. This role offers direct contributions to business growth and valuable sales experience that can pave the way for future career opportunities within Kraft Heinz.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

· Own and lead sales efforts in your assigned territory, driving branded market share and profitability in alignment with Kraft Heinz values.

· Execute the Foodservice Sales Playbook to ensure success in the market.

· Develop and implement profitable sales strategies with local and national distributors while supporting operator needs.

· Build and maintain strong distributor relationships, actively participating in local events and initiatives.

· Drive penetration of priority SKUs, focusing on strategic, branded, and high-margin products.

· Identify and manage a pipeline of high-value sales opportunities, collaborating with Sales Operations, Finance, and Supply teams.

· Lead bottom-up sales planning, crafting data-driven proposals based on customer needs and market insights.

· Own the full sales cycle—from generating interest to securing commitments and closing deals.

· Meet and exceed revenue targets while effectively managing trade budgets and business expenses.

· Execute quarterly and annual sales and marketing priorities, including new product launches and limited-time offers.

· Support the Sales Operations & Planning team by accurately forecasting demand and submitting Volume Submission Forms (VSFs) for new or renewed business.

Expected Experience & Required Skills

· Bachelor’s degree preferred in business, marketing, sales, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

· 1 to 3 years of sales, customer service, or business development experience, preferably in foodservice, consumer packaged goods (CPG), or a related industry.

· Self-motivated and results-driven with a proactive approach to problem-solving and overcoming challenges.

· Strong analytical skills—ability to interpret sales data, market trends, and financial reports to support business decisions.

· Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to sell and influence both internal and external stakeholders.

· Relationship-building expertise, with the ability to establish and maintain strong partnerships with distributors, operators, and key decision-makers.

· Ability to adapt selling strategies to virtual platforms (MS Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, FaceTime, etc.).

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).

· Ability to lift up to 50 pounds when needed (e.g., delivering customer samples).

· Valid driver’s license and ability to meet MVR requirements.

· Willingness to travel overnight as needed (varies by territory).

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is considered a Remote based role that can be performed from a home office with expected travel. Additionally, this role requires working a salaried, exempt schedule to best execute against customer and internal expectations.

Looking for candidates based in Rhode Island or Mid-west Massachusetts due to customer connectivity.

Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values.

New Hire Base Salary Range:

$68,900.00 - $86,100.00

The In-House Clinical Research Associate/MedTech Site Manager 1 will be a critical team member reporting directly to the Director of Clinical Affairs, to support clinical trial operations for the firm’s clientele. Responsible for management of investigator site and Clinical Research Associate (CRA) activities for assigned studies. Your Opportunity

This role is for a Civil Engineer focusing on Mission Critical Data Center projects within our Community Development Group. Within this team, you will have the opportunity to work on Data Center projects of various sizes across the country. The Mission Critical space requires a very proactive, responsive, and efficient design team with projects serving Fortune 10 companies who are making headlines with transformational projects.

The engineers on this team are a core design group dedicated to serving Data Center clients and similar major commercial programs. The projects they work on require a variety and diverse set of skills to assist our clients with site due diligence, design, entitlement approvals, permitting, and construction. Within this team you will be exposed to different design requirements across multiple geographic regions as well as different Mission Critical and commercial projects of various sizes and operational needs. The projects that you may be assigned to will be broad, varied, and diverse in scope.

This position involves working collaboratively within the Mission Critical core design team, project partners, and various different services in the development of private civil site designs; construction plans and specifications; preparing reports, studies, and construction contract documents; computing quantities and preparing opinions of cost; performing field observations and assisting in the coordination and management of construction activities.

  • Participates in constructability review.
