raw.description:
Who We Are:

SOCi is the leader in AI-powered marketing solutions for multi-location businesses. With its proprietary Genius AI™ and suite of Genius Agents™, SOCi provides a first-of-its-kind, AI-powered digital workforce capable of handling the workload of 1,000 local marketers™, empowering brands to achieve unmatched digital visibility, strengthen customer engagement, and scale faster than ever before.

SOCi is recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies, and is trusted by nearly 1,000 top brands—including Ford, Ace Hardware, Kumon, Liberty Tax, and more—to automate and optimize local marketing tasks across all locations. Founded in 2012 and backed by leading strategic investors, SOCi is transforming how multi-location brands manage and scale their marketing efforts. You can view our Awards and Accolades here!

About the Role

The Local Visibility Optimization Specialist is responsible for supporting the delivery of SOCi’s Local Visibility Optimization professional services offering to customers. This role serves as a hands-on local SEO practitioner, helping customers improve local search visibility, discoverability, rankings, listings performance, and overall local digital presence.

This role supports customer outcomes through SEO audits, performance analysis, keyword tracking, competitive analysis, monthly reporting, action tracking, and customer-facing recommendations. The Local Visibility Optimization Specialist helps translate local SEO data, customer goals, and market trends into clear insights and practical recommendations that support improved local visibility performance.

The Local Visibility Optimization Specialist partners with the Manager, Local Visibility Optimization, Customer Success Managers, Professional Services team members, and other internal stakeholders to ensure customers receive consistent, accurate, and actionable guidance aligned to the scope of SOCi’s Local Visibility Optimization service offering.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Execute assigned Local Visibility Optimization professional services work with quality, consistency, and customer impact
  • Serve as a customer-facing local SEO specialist supporting local search visibility, listings optimization, keyword performance, and local discoverability
  • Conduct SEO audits and contribute to customer-specific success plans that identify opportunities, priorities, and recommended actions
  • Build and deliver monthly SEO analysis reports that clearly explain performance trends, visibility shifts, and recommended next steps
  • Support keyword tracking and performance analysis, including GeoRank-related insights where applicable
  • Track recommendations, actions, and optimizations throughout the customer lifecycle to support measurement and continuous improvement
  • Conduct competitive analysis to help customers understand their local visibility position relative to approved competitors
  • Participate in customer meetings and QBRs to present insights, discuss recommendations, and support alignment on priorities
  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and the Manager, Local Visibility Optimization to ensure Local Visibility Optimization work supports broader customer goals and engagement strategies
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer deliverables, reporting quality, internal workflows, and execution consistency
  • Communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders regarding recommendations, dependencies, risks, timelines, and outcomes
  • Maintain strong understanding of local SEO trends, Google Business Profile, local landing pages, listings performance, search behavior, and emerging local discovery channels

ADDITIONAL ROLE-SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain and update Local Visibility Optimization templates, reporting frameworks, audit materials, and customer-facing deliverables
  • Support consistent execution of local SEO advisory services at scale
  • Assist with internal enablement for Customer Success teams by providing local SEO insights, reporting context, and service clarification support
  • Help identify customer requirements, including data access needs such as Google Search Console access, and communicate those requirements to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Reinforce service boundaries and escalate scope-related questions when customer requests fall outside the approved service package
  • Partner with the Manager, Local Visibility Optimization to identify recurring customer trends, reporting needs, product feedback, and visibility-related challenges
  • Stay current on local SEO best practices, search engine updates, local ranking factors, and changes impacting customer visibility across listings, search, maps, and local landing pages

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION:

  • 3+ years of experience in SEO, local SEO, digital marketing, marketing analytics, professional services, customer success, or a related customer-facing advisory role
  • Strong understanding of local SEO, Google Business Profile, listings optimization, local landing pages, keyword strategy, and search visibility best practices
  • Experience analyzing performance data and translating insights into actionable customer recommendations
  • Experience creating customer-facing reports, presentations, audits, or strategic recommendations
  • Experience working directly with customers in an advisory, consulting, professional services, customer success, or digital marketing capacity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple customer deliverables, reporting timelines, and follow-up actions simultaneously
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION:

  • Experience supporting multi-location brands, franchise businesses, or enterprise customers
  • Experience with Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Looker Data Studio, GeoRank tools, listings platforms, or local marketing platforms
  • Experience supporting paid professional services or customer-facing advisory packages
  • Experience conducting competitive analysis across listings, local landing pages, search visibility, or local market performance
  • Experience in SaaS, MarTech, digital marketing, local marketing, or agency environments
  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, or Support teams to improve customer outcomes
  • Familiarity with SOCi’s product suite, local marketing platform capabilities, and customer use cases

SOCi expects to pay a base salary in the range of 49,500 CAD- 54,000 CAD base salary. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

What SOCi Provides to You

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package (full-time permanent, non-contract roles only)
    • Health insurance plans, dental, and vision
    • Wellness incentives
    • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • Flexible Work Environment (full-time, non-contract roles only)
    • Flexible paid time off
    • Quarterly wellness days
    • Paid holidays
    • Unique employee engagement programs
  • Empowering Career Growth and Success

What’s Important at SOCi

Led by a team of industry experts, SOCi is leading the pack in agentic marketing for multi-location brands. Our passionate team of SOCialites work from home around the globe!
Our collaborative, dynamic culture allows our teams to work cross-functionally and optimize productivity. We are a fast-paced, agile environment where thought leadership and input are encouraged. If you are looking for a place where you can come and make a difference in the way enterprise organizations utilize social technology, then SOCi is for you. Visit for more information.

raw.excerpt: Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces.
raw.description:
Case IQ is a leading B2B SaaS company in the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) space, helping organizations build safer, more accountable workplaces. We offer a comprehensive suite of solutions that enable organizations to move from reactive approaches to proactive risk management. Our software helps teams across compliance, HR, legal, and investigations report, manage, investigate, and prevent workplace risk - including ethics violations, fraud, harassment, discrimination, security incidents, and third-party issues - so they can better protect their people, culture, and business.

Backed by over 25 years of domain expertise and trusted by Fortune 500 companies, Case IQ has supported the management of millions of cases and helped mitigate billions in financial and reputational risk.

Role Summary

We are seeking a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our team. This role is crucial in managing and optimizing our infrastructure and deployment processes, ensuring high availability and performance of our services. The Case IQ and Lextegrity product suites process millions of transactions, providing risk scores and insights that help compliance users prioritize reviews and proactively avoid risks like fraud, corruption, and bribery.

What You'll Do

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and optimize our infrastructure across Azure and AWS, ensuring the seamless operation of services such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker Swarm, Azure Application Insights, Amazon ECS, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda, Application Load Balancers (ALB), API Gateway, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and more. Support platform administration and security while identifying cost-optimization opportunities as we scale.
  • Deployment Automation: Develop and manage CI/CD, automating deployment processes to ensure rapid and reliable software delivery.
  • AI-Enabled Operations and Development: Drive the adoption of vibe coding, agentic SDLC, and AIOps practices to improve development velocity, observability, incident response, automation, and platform operations.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance and observability metrics and implement improvements to ensure the high availability and scalability of the compliance monitoring platform.
  • Security and Compliance: Implement security and compliance best practices, ensuring all systems and processes adhere to industry standards and regulations.
  • Quality Assurance: Work closely with QA to define a testing strategy that empowers them to run automated tests and deploy to their own environments and enables high confidence in functionality with each deployment.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with development to ensure the seamless integration and deployment of new features and updates.
  • Incident Management: Respond to and resolve system incidents, minimizing downtime and ensuring the reliability of our services.

Who You Are

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of experience in a DevOps or similar role.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong experience with Azure and AWS services and infrastructure as code. Solid familiarity with containerization technologies, particularly Docker. Experience operating modern SaaS web applications, including auto-scaling, load balancing, gateways, monitoring, observability, and secrets management. Multi-cloud experience is a plus.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform and CDK) for managing cloud resources.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Proven experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with Github Action and Jenkins, with a focus on automation and efficiency.
  • AI-Enabled Operations and Development: Experience with and knowledge of vibe coding, agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, and AIOps tools for intelligent monitoring, incident response, automation, and operational optimization.
  • Security Practices and Acumen: Knowledge of security best practices and experience implementing security measures in cloud environments. Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 web application security risks and a strong understanding of software security principles.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team and engage stakeholders across the organization.

What Success Looks Like

  • 30 Days: Complete onboarding and required security/compliance training. Build a strong understanding of Case IQ’s platform architecture, cloud environments, deployment processes, observability tools, current infrastructure priorities, and incident-management practices.
  • 60 Days: Begin contributing to infrastructure maintenance, CI/CD improvements, monitoring, and deployment workflows with support from the team. Identify quick wins related to reliability, security, documentation, automation, or cost optimization.
  • 90 Days: Independently manage assigned infrastructure and deployment work, troubleshoot common production issues, and contribute to reliable, well-documented releases. Partner effectively with Development and QA to improve deployment confidence and environment readiness.
  • 6 Months: Deliver meaningful improvements to platform reliability, scalability, observability, security, or deployment efficiency. Help advance infrastructure-as-code, automated testing/deployment practices, and AI-enabled operational workflows.
  • 1 Year: Serve as a trusted DevOps partner across Engineering—strengthening the stability, security, and scalability of the platform; reducing operational friction and incident risk; and helping shape a mature, automation-first, AI-enabled SDLC.

Perks and Benefits

  • Work remotely within a flexible work environment (our team spans 7 countries!)
  • Competitive company-paid benefits plan starting day 1!
  • Generous professional development budget
  • RRSP/ 401k matching program
  • Half-day Fridays in the summer

Selected candidates will be contacted through BambooHR (please check your junk mail).

Case IQ is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are given consideration regardless of race, religion, color, gender, sex,

age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected class as provided in applicable employment laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at .

Salary: 110-130k CAD

raw.description:
Location: Remote – United States

About Axuall

Built with leading healthcare systems, Axuall is a clinical workforce intelligence company built on top of a national real-time practitioner data network. It enables healthcare systems, staffing firms, telehealth organizations, and health plans to accelerate clinician onboarding, improve hiring and workforce planning, and maintain accurate provider data across enterprise systems. By delivering trusted data, AI-powered insights, and seamless data exchange, Axuall empowers healthcare organizations to improve operational efficiency, strengthen clinical coverage, and support revenue capture.

Axuall's investors and the organizations they represent comprise over two dozen of the nation's leading healthcare organizations that recognize the imperative to improve clinical workforce efficiency amid significant economic and staffing challenges.

About the Role

We are seeking a senior enterprise sales professional with extensive healthcare experience who can identify and cultivate trusted C-suite relationships and lead long, complex sales processes to close. This is a senior, quota-carrying individual contributor role reporting to the Chief Growth Officer.

You will own new customer acquisition across large healthcare organizations, from account strategy and prospecting through executive engagement, business-case development, negotiation, and signature. You are self-motivated, excel at building trusted relationships, and bring strong integrity and accountability to your work. You are a collaborative team player who welcomes coaching and contributes to others’ success. You thrive in early-stage, high-growth companies, bringing resourcefulness, discipline, and a commitment to Axuall’s growth and long-term success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a defined new logo revenue target and drive new customer acquisition through strategic named-account plans aligned with Axuall’s priority customer segments and territory strategy.
  • Generate qualified pipeline through proactive outreach, executive relationships, referrals, industry events, and partnerships, working closely with Marketing.
  • Map large enterprise accounts and cultivate C-suite relationships by engaging key influencers, decision makers, sponsors, champions, and economic buyers. Build consensus across clinical, operational, technology, and financial stakeholders.
  • Create mutual action plans that establish customer commitments, decision milestones, procurement requirements, implementation dependencies, and a realistic path to signature.
  • Apply Challenger selling principles to uncover business priorities, challenge the status quo, and elevate departmental needs into enterprise problems. Develop customer-validated business cases that connect a seven-figure investment to a seven-figure problem, quantifying financial impact, cost of inaction, expected value, and time to value.
  • Drive long, complex pursuits to signature using MEDDPICC to qualify opportunities and navigate funding, competing priorities, technical evaluations, procurement, and negotiations.
  • Independently lead proposals and commercial negotiations within approved pricing and contracting parameters. Develop creative solutions with internal experts while setting realistic customer expectations.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and evidence-based forecasts, surface risks early, and focus effort on opportunities with a credible path to close.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and leadership to advance pursuits, address workflow and integration needs, and translate customer and win/loss feedback into stronger messaging and product insights. Ensure clear handoffs to Implementation, Customer Success, and Strategic Account Management.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of enterprise healthcare sales experience, with deep understanding of health system operations, industry trends, regulatory considerations, executive priorities, financial pressures, and purchasing processes.
  • A demonstrable record of meeting or exceeding quota and winning new enterprise customers within the past five years, including personally generating pipeline and closing complex, seven-figure SaaS, data, analytics, or workflow agreements.
  • Demonstrated ability to cultivate C-suite relationships, identify the economic buyer, build consensus, and secure funding when budget or urgency is initially unclear.
  • Challenger Sales experience, or a comparable insight-led approach, supported by disciplined MEDDPICC qualification and forecasting.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, commercial judgment, and collaborative execution. Experience contributing to growth in early-stage, high-growth, or VC/PE-backed companies is preferred, as is familiarity with provider data, credentialing, clinical workforce planning, or enterprise integrations.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the qualiﬁcations listed. We recognize that talent and potential come in many forms, and we value diverse experiences and perspectives. If you're passionate about this opportunity and believe your skills and experience align with the overall requirements, we encourage you to submit your application.

What You'll Get From Us

We offer a wide range of beneﬁts for our team including:

  • Comprehensive Health Insurance
  • 401(k) with Employer Match
  • Wellness Stipend
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Work From Home Stipend
  • Remote Work Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO
  • Paid parental leave

In addition, Axuall is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that reﬂects the communities we serve and empowers every employee to reach their full potential. We encourage DEI through our Diversity in Tech (DiT) Employee Resource Group along with impactful programming that supports and fosters a place of belonging for our team members every day.

Equal Employment Opportunity & Pay Equity Commitment

Axuall is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Axuall maintains pay-equity practices that prohibit reliance on salary history and require that compensation decisions be supported by legitimate, job-related factors.

Interview Path

  1. Initial Screen (Key Stakeholders)
  2. Hiring Manager Interview
  3. Case Study: Enterprise Deal Review (Map a complex enterprise sale from prospecting to close, including stakeholders, business value, qualification, decision process, and key milestones)
  4. CEO
  5. References
  6. Hiring Decision

This role may be performed from any U.S. jurisdiction in which Axuall is registered to do business. Please note that certain localities may impose additional employment requirements that will be addressed during the hiring process. Please also note that we are currently unable to sponsor visas. While this role is remote-first, we require employees to attend an in-person orientation at our headquarters in Cleveland, Ohio. There may also be occasional instances where travel to our HQ is needed.

Pay Transparency & Compensation

Base Salary Range (Good-Faith Estimate): $165,000 - $180,000Employment Classification: Exempt / Full-timeAdditional Compensation: Performance-Based Incentive CompensationPay Frequency: Semi-monthly

The posted range represents Axuall’s reasonable and good-faith estimate of the compensation the Company expects to pay for the position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity.

Serás la persona de referencia para consultar bases de datos, dar sentido a datos desordenados y construir dashboards que permitan al equipo tomar decisiones basadas en datos.

Lo que harás:

  • Escribir queries SQL complejas y altamente optimizadas para extraer datos de nuestras bases de datos.

Lo que buscamos:

  • Mentalidad analítica: Fuertes habilidades de resolución de problemas y capacidad para traducir datos en insights de negocio fáciles de entender.

Puntos extra (deseables):

  • Experiencia construyendo dashboards y visualizaciones usando Metabase.
  • Familiaridad con datos generados por automatizaciones de WhatsApp (tracking de engagement, métricas de funnel e interacciones de chatbots).
